title_en: Training-Free Vector Quantization via Gaussian VAEs
title_zh: 通过高斯 VAE 实现免训练的向量量化

sentences.en: Vector-quantized variational autoencoders (VQ-VAEs) are discrete autoencoders that compress images into discrete tokens.
sentences.zh: 向量量化变分自编码器（VQ-VAE）是将图像压缩为离散词元的离散自编码器。

sentences.en: However, they are difficult to train due to discretization.
sentences.zh: 然而，由于离散化，它们难以训练。

sentences.en: In this paper, we propose a simple yet effective technique dubbed __Gaussian Quant (GQ)__, which first trains a Gaussian VAE under certain constraints and then converts it into a VQ-VAE without additional training.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们提出一种简单而有效的技术，称为 __Gaussian Quant (GQ)__，它先在特定约束下训练一个高斯 VAE，然后无需额外训练即将其转换为 VQ-VAE。

sentences.en: For conversion, GQ generates random Gaussian noise as a codebook and finds the closest noise vector to the posterior mean.
sentences.zh: 为完成转换，GQ 生成随机高斯噪声作为码本，并找到与后验均值最接近的噪声向量。

sentences.en: Theoretically, we prove that when the logarithm of the codebook size exceeds the bits-back coding rate of the Gaussian VAE, a small quantization error is guaranteed.
sentences.zh: 在理论上，我们证明当码本大小的对数超过高斯 VAE 的比特追溯编码率时，能保证较小的量化误差。

sentences.en: Practically, we propose a heuristic to train Gaussian VAEs for effective conversion, named the target divergence constraint (TDC).
sentences.zh: 在实践中，我们提出一个训练高斯 VAE 以实现有效转换的启发式方法，称为目标散度约束（TDC）。

sentences.en: Empirically, we show that GQ outperforms previous VQ-VAEs, such as VQGAN, FSQ, LFQ, and BSQ, on both UNet and ViT architectures.
sentences.zh: 在经验上，我们表明 GQ 在 UNet 与 ViT 两种架构上都优于先前的 VQ-VAE（例如 VQGAN、FSQ、LFQ 与 BSQ）。

sentences.en: Furthermore, TDC also improves previous Gaussian VAE discretization methods, such as TokenBridge.
sentences.zh: 此外，TDC 也改进了先前的多元高斯 VAE 离散化方法，例如 TokenBridge。

sentences.en: The source code is provided in https://github.com/tongdaxu/VQ-VAE-from-Gaussian-VAE.
sentences.zh: 源码已在 https://github.com/tongdaxu/VQ-VAE-from-Gaussian-VAE 提供。

title_en: Training-Trajectory-Aware Token Selection
title_zh: 训练轨迹感知的词元选择

sentences.en: Efficient distillation is a key pathway for converting expensive reasoning capability into deployable efficiency, yet in the frontier regime where the student already has strong reasoning ability, naive continual distillation often yields limited gains or even degradation.
sentences.zh: 高效蒸馏是将昂贵的推理能力转化为可部署效率的关键途径，然而在前沿机制（即学生已具有强推理能力）中，朴素的持续蒸馏往往带来有限增益甚至退化。

sentences.en: We observe a characteristic training phenomenon: even as loss decreases monotonically, all performance metrics can drop sharply at almost the same bottle-neck, before gradually recovering.
sentences.zh: 我们观察到一种特征性训练现象：即使损失单调下降，所有性能指标都可能在同一瓶颈点附近急剧下降，随后才逐渐恢复。

sentences.en: We further uncover a token-level mechanism: confidence bifurcates into steadily increasing Imitation-Anchor Tokens that quickly anchor optimization and other yet-to-learn tokens whose confidence is suppressed until after the bottleneck.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步揭示一种词元级机制：置信度分化为稳定上升的模仿锚定词元（它们快速锚定优化）与其他待学词元（其置信度在瓶颈之前一直被压制）。

sentences.en: And the characteristic that these two types of tokens cannot coexist is the root cause of the failure in continual distillation.
sentences.zh: 而这两类词元无法共存这一特性，正是持续蒸馏失败的根源。

sentences.en: To this end, we propose Training-Trajectory-Aware Token Selection (T3S) to reconstruct the training objective at the token level, clearing the optimization path for yet-to-learn tokens.
sentences.zh: 为此，我们提出训练轨迹感知的词元选择（T3S），在词元级重建训练目标，为待学词元扫清优化路径。

sentences.en: T3S yields consistent gains in both AR and dLLM settings: with only hundreds of examples, Qwen3-8B surpasses DeepSeek-R1 on competitive reasoning benchmarks, Qwen3-32B approaches Qwen3-235B, and T3-trained LLaDA-2.0-Mini exceeds its AR baseline, achieving state-of-the-art performance among all of 16B-scale no-think models.
sentences.zh: T3S 在自回归（AR）与扩散 LLM（dLLM）设定中都带来一致增益：仅用数百个示例，Qwen3-8B 在竞争性推理基准上超越 DeepSeek-R1，Qwen3-32B 逼近 Qwen3-235B，而 T3 训练的 LLaDA-2.0-Mini 超越其 AR 基线，在全部 16B 规模“不加思考”模型中取得最先进性能。

authors.name: Jiaqi Hu
authors.institution: College of Computer Science and Technology, Zhejiang University

title_en: Training–Inference Consistent Segmented Execution for Long-Context LLMs
title_zh: 面向长上下文 LLM 的训练-推理一致的分段执行

sentences.en: Transformer-based large language models face severe scalability challenges in long-context generation due to the computational and memory costs of full-context attention.
sentences.zh: 基于 Transformer 的大型语言模型因全上下文注意力的计算与内存成本，在长上下文生成中面临严峻的可扩展性挑战。

sentences.en: Under practical computation and memory constraints, many inference-efficient long-context methods improve efficiency by adopting bounded-context or segment-level execution only during inference, while continuing to train models under full-context attention, resulting in a mismatch between training and inference execution and state-transition semantics.
sentences.zh: 在实用的计算与内存约束下，许多推理高效的长上下文方法通过在推理时采用有界上下文或分段级执行来提升效率，同时继续在全上下文注意力下训练模型，导致训练与推理执行及状态转移语义之间不匹配。

sentences.en: Based on this insight, we propose a training-consistent segment-level generation framework, in which training and inference follow the same segment-level forward execution semantics.
sentences.zh: 基于这一洞见，我们提出一个训练一致的段级生成框架，其中训练与推理遵循相同的段级前向执行语义。

sentences.en: During training, consistency with inference is enforced by restricting gradient propagation to KV states carried over from the immediately preceding segment, while permitting head-specific access to past KV states during the forward pass without involving them in gradient propagation.
sentences.zh: 在训练期间，通过将梯度传播限制到从紧邻前一段携带过来的 KV 状态来强制执行与推理的一致性，同时允许前向传播期间按头访问过去的 KV 状态（不将其纳入梯度传播）。

sentences.en: Across long-context benchmarks, our approach achieves performance comparable to full-context attention, while achieving competitive latency--memory trade-offs against strong inference-efficient baselines, and substantially improving scalability at very long context lengths (e.g., approximately $6\times$ lower peak prefill memory at 128K compared to full-context attention with FlashAttention).
sentences.zh: 跨长上下文基准，我们的方法实现了与全上下文注意力相当的性能，同时在强推理高效基线上取得有竞争力的延迟-内存权衡，并大幅提升极长上下文下的可扩展性：例如，128K 处相对带 FlashAttention 的全上下文注意力峰值预填充内存降低约 $6\times$）。

authors.name: Qianyi Cai
authors.institution: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology

title_en: Trajectory Consistency for One-Step Generation on Euler Mean Flows
title_zh: 欧拉均值流上的一步生成轨迹一致性

sentences.en: We propose \emph{Euler Mean Flows (EMF)}, a flow-based generative framework for one-step and few-step generation that enforces long-range trajectory consistency with minimal sampling cost.
sentences.zh: 我们提出 \emph{欧拉均值流（EMF）}，一个面向一步与少步生成的基于流的生成框架，它以极小的采样成本强制长程轨迹一致性。

sentences.en: The key idea of EMF is to replace the trajectory consistency constraint, which is difficult to supervise and optimize over long time scales, with a principled linear surrogate that enables direct data supervision for long-horizon flow-map compositions.
sentences.zh: EMF 的关键思想是用一个有原则的线性替代物替换难以在长时间尺度上监督与优化的轨迹一致性约束，从而实现长视界流映射组合的直接数据监督。

sentences.en: We derive this approximation from the semigroup formulation of flow-based models and show that, under mild regularity assumptions, it faithfully approximates the original consistency objective while being substantially easier to optimize.
sentences.zh: 我们从基于流的模型的半群表述推导这一近似，并表明在温和的正则性假设下，它忠实地近似原始一致性目标，同时更易于优化。

sentences.en: This formulation leads to a unified, JVP-free training framework that supports both $u$-prediction and $x_1$-prediction variants, avoiding explicit Jacobian computations and significantly reducing memory and computational overhead.
sentences.zh: 这一表述导致一个统一、无 JVP 的训练框架，它同时支持 $\boldsymbol{u}$-预测与 $x_1$-预测变体，避免显式 Jacobian 计算并显著降低内存与计算开销。

sentences.en: Experiments on image synthesis, particle-based geometry generation, and functional generation demonstrate improved optimization stability and sample quality under fixed sampling budgets, together with approximately $50\%$ reductions in training time and memory consumption compared to existing one-step methods for image generation.
sentences.zh: 在图像合成、基于粒子的几何生成与函数生成上的实验展示了在固定采样预算下优化稳定性与样本质量的改进，同时相对现有的一步图像生成方法，训练时间与内存消耗约降低 $50\%$。

topic: General Machine Learning->Unsupervised and Semi-supervised Learning
title_en: Trajectory Seriation via Spectral Tangent Alignment and Global Embedding
title_zh: 通过谱切向对齐与全局嵌入实现轨迹排序

sentences.en: We study linear seriation from noisy point clouds: given samples from an unknown one-dimensional curve embedded in $\mathbb{R}^d$, recover their latent order along the curve, up to reversal.
sentences.zh: 我们研究带噪点云上的线性排序：给定嵌入于 $\mathbb{R}^d$ 的未知一维曲线样本，恢复它们沿曲线的潜在顺序（容许逆转）。

sentences.en: Unlike much of the seriation literature, which starts from a precomputed similarity matrix, this setting retains ambient coordinates and therefore local geometric information.
sentences.zh: 与从预计算相似矩阵出发的多数排序文献不同，这一设定保留环境坐标，从而保留局部几何信息。

sentences.en: We propose STAGE, a geometric ordering method that estimates local tangent directions by neighborhood PCA, resolves their sign ambiguity through a graph-wide $\mathbb{Z}_2$ synchronization step, and constructs signed local displacement estimates by projecting ambient differences onto the oriented tangents.
sentences.zh: 我们提出 STAGE，一种几何排序方法，它通过邻域 PCA 估计局部切方向，通过图范围的 $\mathbb{Z}_2$ 同步步骤解决其符号歧义，并通过将环境差分投影到定向切线上构造有符号的局部位移估计。

sentences.en: These increments are then integrated into a global scalar embedding through an inhomogeneous least-squares problem, equivalently a Laplacian linear system with a nonzero right-hand side, and the final order is obtained by sorting the embedding.
sentences.zh: 这些增量随后通过一个非齐次最小二乘问题（等价于带非零右侧项的 Laplacian 线性系统）积分到全局标量嵌入中，最终顺序通过排序该嵌入获得。

sentences.en: We prove a finite-sample Kendall's $\tau$ recovery bound that makes explicit the roles of curvature, noise, neighborhood scale, sampling density, and graph connectivity.
sentences.zh: 我们证明一个有限样本 Kendall 的 $\boldsymbol{\tau}$ 恢复界，它显式刻画曲率、噪声、邻域尺度、采样密度与图连通性的作用。

sentences.en: Empirically, STAGE gives accurate and fast order recovery on high-dimensional synthetic curves, compares favorably with spectral seriation, 1D UMAP, 1D t-SNE, Recanati's method, LTSA, and SABRE, and produces meaningful pseudotime orderings on single-cell RNA-seq datasets.
sentences.zh: 在经验上，STAGE 在高维合成曲线上给出准确且快速的顺序恢复，相比谱排序、1D UMAP、1D t-SNE、Recanati 方法、LTSA 与 SABRE 具有竞争力，并在单细胞 RNA-seq 数据集上产生有意义的伪时间排序。

title_en: Trajectory Stitching for Solving Inverse Problems with Flow-Based Models
title_zh: 用轨迹拼接求解基于流模型的逆问题

sentences.en: Flow-based generative models have emerged as powerful priors for solving inverse problems.
sentences.zh: 基于流的生成模型已作为求解逆问题的强大先验而出现。

sentences.en: One option is to directly optimize the initial latent code (noise), such that the flow output solves the inverse problem.
sentences.zh: 一种选项是直接优化初始潜码（噪声），使流输出求解该逆问题。

sentences.en: However, this requires backpropagating through the entire generative trajectory, incurring high memory costs and numerical instability.
sentences.zh: 然而，这需要反向传播整个生成轨迹，招致高内存成本与数值不稳定性。

sentences.en: We propose MS-Flow, which represents the trajectory as a sequence of intermediate latent states rather than a single initial code.
sentences.zh: 我们提出 MS-Flow，它将轨迹表示为中间潜状态的序列，而非单个初始码。

sentences.en: By enforcing the flow dynamics locally and coupling segments through trajectory-matching penalties, MS-Flow alternates between updating intermediate latent states and enforcing consistency with observed data.
sentences.zh: 通过局部强制流动力学并通过轨迹匹配惩罚耦合各段，MS-Flow 在更新中间潜状态与强制与观测数据的一致性之间交替进行。

sentences.en: This reduces memory consumption while improving reconstruction quality.
sentences.zh: 这降低了内存消耗并改善了重建质量。

sentences.en: We demonstrate the effectiveness of MS-Flow over existing methods on image recovery and inverse problems, including inpainting, super-resolution, and computed tomography.
sentences.zh: 我们在图像恢复与逆问题（包括修复、超分辨与计算机断层扫描）上展示了 MS-Flow 相对现有方法的有效性。

title_en: Trajectory-Aware Certified Decentralized Unlearning via SGD Stability
title_zh: 通过 SGD 稳定性实现轨迹感知的认证去中心化遗忘

sentences.en: Decentralized Unlearning (DU) aims to remove the influence of specific clients from a collaboratively trained global model.
sentences.zh: 去中心化遗忘（DU）旨在从协作训练的全局模型中移除特定客户端的影响。

sentences.en: However, existing methods suffer from  strong reliance on static, problem-specific hyperparameters or restrictive convexity assumptions, limiting their general applicability.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有方法强烈依赖静态、问题特异的超参数或限制性的凸性假设，限制了其通用适用性。

sentences.en: To overcome these limitations, we propose **TRA**jectory-aware **CE**rtified **D**ecentralized **U**nlearning (**TRACE-DU**), a generic unlearning framework for decentralized training.
sentences.zh: 为克服这些局限，我们提出 **TRACE-DU**（**TRA**jectory-aware **CE**rtified **D**ecentralized **U**nlearning，轨迹感知的认证去中心化遗忘），一个面向去中心化训练的通用遗忘框架。

sentences.en: **TRACE-DU** introduces a fine-grained sensitivity analysis that leverages local SGD updates and decentralized training dynamics, thereby eliminating the need for convexity assumptions and reducing dependence on manually tuned parameters.
sentences.zh: **TRACE-DU** 引入一种细粒度敏感性分析，它利用局部 SGD 更新与去中心化训练动力学，从而消除对凸性假设的需求并减少对人工调参的依赖。

sentences.en: By integrating strategic checkpoint selection with calibrated noise perturbation, the proposed framework enables efficient certified unlearning.
sentences.zh: 通过整合战略性检查点选择与校准噪声扰动，所提出的框架实现高效的认证遗忘。

sentences.en: Moreover, we exploit historical model trajectories to extend this framework, enabling it to naturally support sequential unlearning requests from an arbitrary number of clients.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们利用历史模型轨迹扩展这一框架，使其天然支持来自任意数量客户的序贯遗忘请求。

sentences.en: We provide theoretical guarantees for certified unlearning and derive sensitivity bounds under both convex and non-convex loss functions.
sentences.zh: 我们为认证遗忘提供理论保证，并在凸与非凸损失函数下推导敏感性界。

sentences.en: Experimental results demonstrate that our framework outperforms state-of-the-art baselines across diverse metrics.
sentences.zh: 实验结果表明，我们的框架在多样指标上优于最先进的基线。

title_en: Trajectory-Aware Heuristic Learning for Combinatorial Search
title_zh: 面向组合搜索的轨迹感知启发式学习

sentences.en: Learning effective value heuristics for combinatorial search is difficult, as prior methods rely on surrogate supervision or costly downstream search to assess progress.
sentences.zh: 为组合搜索学习有效的价值启发式是困难的，因为先前方法依赖代理监督或成本高昂的下游搜索来评估进展。

sentences.en: We introduce a trajectory-aware probabilistic framework that models uncertainty in cost-to-go labels instead of treating them as fixed targets.
sentences.zh: 我们引入一个轨迹感知的概率框架，它对代价到目标标签中不确定性建模，而非将它们视为固定目标。

sentences.en: Heuristic learning is cast as inference over state trajectories using an HMM-style model, where estimated depth-change dynamics define transitions and forward-backward inference yields soft supervision.
sentences.zh: 启发式学习被表述为使用类 HMM 模型对状态轨迹的推断，其中估计的深度变化动力学定义转移，前向-后向推断产生软监督。

sentences.en: To evaluate heuristic quality without search, we propose a large-scale local ranking metric that measures a model's ability to order neighboring states.
sentences.zh: 为在无需搜索的情况下评估启发式质量，我们提出一个大规模局部排序指标，它衡量模型对相邻状态排序的能力。

sentences.en: On the Rubik's Cube, our approach consistently improves local ranking accuracy and downstream search performance under matched computational budgets.
sentences.zh: 在魔方上，我们的方法在匹配计算预算下一致改善了局部排序准确率与下游搜索性能。

title_en: Trajectory-Aware Spiking DiTs Conversion via Membrane Potential Error-Feedback
title_zh: 通过膜电位误差反馈实现轨迹感知的脉冲 DiT 转换

sentences.en: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) have achieved state-of-the-art generative performance, yet their iterative denoising process remains computationally expensive and energy-intensive.
sentences.zh: 扩散 Transformer（DiT）已取得最先进的生成性能，但其迭代去噪过程仍计算昂贵、能耗密集。

sentences.en: Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) offer a promising neuromorphic alternative for energy efficiency; however, the non-differentiable nature of spiking neurons makes direct training difficult, positioning ANN-to-SNN conversion as a more practical, training-free solution.
sentences.zh: 脉冲神经网络（SNN）为能效提供了一种有前景的神经形态替代方案；然而，脉冲神经元不可微的性质使直接训练变得困难，使 ANN 到 SNN 的转换成为更实用、免训练的解决方案。

sentences.en: In this paper, we identify a critical challenge unique to converting DiTs: standard fixed-scale spiking neurons fail to accommodate the highly dynamic activation ranges inherent across denoising steps.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们识别出 DiT 转换独有的一个关键挑战：标准的固定尺度脉冲神经元无法适配跨去噪步骤固有的高度动态激活范围。

sentences.en: This mismatch leads to cumulative  errors that significantly degrade generation fidelity.
sentences.zh: 这种错配导致累积误差，显著降低生成保真度。

sentences.en: To resolve this, we propose a novel conversion framework featuring Multi-Threshold (MT) neurons and a Membrane Potential Error-Feedback (MPEF) mechanism.
sentences.zh: 为解决这一点，我们提出一个采用多阈值（MT）神经元与膜电位误差反馈（MPEF）机制的新颖转换框架。

sentences.en: MT neurons expand the expressive capacity of discrete spikes by employing a multi-level firing strategy.
sentences.zh: MT 神经元通过采用多级发放策略扩展离散脉冲的表达能力。

sentences.en: Concurrently, MPEF exploits the temporal correlation between successive denoising steps to recycle residual membrane potential, effectively compensating for information loss and mitigating distribution shifts without retraining.
sentences.zh: 同时，MPEF 利用连续去噪步骤之间的时间相关性来回收残余膜电位，在无需重训练的情况下有效补偿信息损失并缓解分布偏移。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on ImageNet demonstrate that our framework achieves competitive generative quality with superior energy efficiency, establishing a new performance benchmark for spiking Diffusion Transformers.
sentences.zh: 在 ImageNet 上的广泛实验表明，我们的框架以优越的能效实现有竞争力的生成质量，为脉冲扩散 Transformer 确立了新的性能基准。

authors.name: Wanli Shi
authors.institution: Mohamed bin Zayed University of Artificial Intelligence

title_en: Trajectory-Level Data Augmentation for Offline Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: 面向离线强化学习的轨迹级数据增强

sentences.en: We propose a data augmentation method for offline reinforcement learning, motivated by active positioning problems.
sentences.zh: 我们提出一种受主动定位问题启发的离线强化学习数据增强方法。

sentences.en: Particularly, our approach enables the training of off-policy models from a limited number of suboptimal trajectories.
sentences.zh: 尤其，我们的方法使得能够从少量次优轨迹训练离策略模型。

sentences.en: We introduce a trajectory-based augmentation technique that exploits task structure and the geometric relationship between rewards, value functions, and mathematical properties of logging policies.
sentences.zh: 我们引入一种基于轨迹的增强技术，它利用任务结构以及奖励、值函数与记录策略数学性质之间的几何关系。

sentences.en: During data collection, our augmentation supports suboptimal logging policies, leading to higher data quality and improved offline reinforcement learning performance.
sentences.zh: 在数据收集期间，我们的增强支持次优记录策略，从而带来更高的数据质量与改进的离线强化学习性能。

sentences.en: We provide theoretical justification for these strategies and validate them empirically across positioning tasks of varying dimensionality and under partial observability.
sentences.zh: 我们为这些策略提供理论依据，并在不同维度的定位任务及部分可观测性下对其进行经验验证。

title_en: Trajectory-Level Speculative Decoding for Diffusion Language Models
title_zh: 面向扩散语言模型的轨迹级投机解码

sentences.en: Diffusion-based language models (dLLMs) enable parallel token generation through iterative denoising, but existing decoding strategies collapse to single-token generation under low confidence, severely limiting throughput.
sentences.zh: 基于扩散的语言模型（dLLM）通过迭代去噪实现并行词元生成，但现有解码策略在低置信度下坍缩为单词元生成，严重限制吞吐量。

sentences.en: Unlike autoregressive models where speculative decoding operates on token sequences in a fixed left-to-right order, dLLMs require speculating over \emph{denoising trajectories}—sequences of multi-token updates with explicit positions and unmasking orders.
sentences.zh: 与投机解码在固定从左到右顺序的词元序列上运作的自回归模型不同，dLLM 需要对*去噪轨迹*进行投机——即带显式位置与解掩码顺序的多词元更新序列。

sentences.en: We develop a trajectory-level speculative framework that constructs draft denoising trajectories via confidence-stratified tree exploration and verifies them through blockwise parallel evaluation with bidirectional attention masking.
sentences.zh: 我们发展一个轨迹级投机框架，它通过置信度分层的树探索构造草稿去噪轨迹，并通过带双向注意力掩码的分块并行评估加以验证。

sentences.en: Our method further introduces inter-block speculation, exploiting diffusion models' bidirectional structure to perform cross-block lookahead.
sentences.zh: 我们的方法进一步引入块间投机，利用扩散模型的双向结构执行跨块前瞻。

sentences.en: We formally characterize when this approach is exact and identify trajectory drift as the fundamental cost of increased parallelism.
sentences.zh: 我们在形式上刻画该方法何时精确，并识别轨迹漂移为增加并行性的根本代价。

sentences.en: Building on Fast-dLLM's dual-cache infrastructure, our framework reduces denoising iterations by 30-40\% and increases tokens-per-step from 2.6 to 4.3, achieving 7-14$\times$ speedup over vanilla dLLMs and 1.3$\times$ over Fast-dLLM with less than 1\% accuracy change across reasoning and code benchmarks.
sentences.zh: 基于 Fast-dLLM 的双缓存基础设施，我们的框架将去噪迭代减少 30-40\%，并将每步词元从 2.6 增加到 4.3，在推理与代码基准上实现相对 vanilla dLLM 的 7-14$\times$ 加速与相对 Fast-dLLM 的 1.3$\times$ 加速，且准确率变化低于 1\%。

title_en: Trajectory-Stabilized Inference for Diffusion-Based Video Inpainting
title_zh: 基于扩散的视频修复的轨迹稳定化推理

sentences.en: Video inpainting aims to restore missing regions while preserving spatial and temporal coherence.
sentences.zh: 视频修复旨在恢复缺失区域，同时保持空间与时间相干性。

sentences.en: Diffusion-based methods achieve strong per-frame reconstruction, but their sampling implicitly generates temporally coupled latent trajectories whose long-horizon stability is not explicitly modeled, leading to a trade-off between temporal consistency and structural detail.
sentences.zh: 基于扩散的方法在逐帧重建上表现强劲，但其采样隐式生成时间耦合的潜在轨迹，其长视界稳定性未被显式建模，导致时间一致性与结构细节之间的权衡。

sentences.en: We revisit video inpainting from the perspective of temporal trajectory stability, viewing temporal inconsistency as instability along time-indexed denoising trajectories rather than an output-level error.
sentences.zh: 我们从时间轨迹稳定性的视角重新审视视频修复，将时间不一致视为沿时间索引去噪轨迹的不稳定性，而非输出级误差。

sentences.en: Based on this view, we propose an inference-time trajectory stabilization framework that monitors motion-aligned deviation and triggers risk-aware correction only when instability accumulates.
sentences.zh: 基于这一视角，我们提出一个推理时轨迹稳定化框架，它监测运动对齐偏差，并仅在不稳定性累积时触发风险感知校正。

sentences.en: It combines sparsely sampled trajectory anchors as stability references with neighborhood-consistent propagation to regulate trajectory evolution while preserving local generative freedom.
sentences.zh: 它将稀疏采样的轨迹锚点作为稳定性参考，与邻域一致传播相结合，以调节轨迹演化，同时保留局部生成自由度。

sentences.en: Implemented as a lightweight control layer in the sampling loop, it selectively contracts unstable trajectories toward motion-consistent manifolds instead of enforcing uniform temporal constraints.
sentences.zh: 作为采样循环中的一个轻量级控制层实现，它选择性地将不稳定轨迹收缩到运动一致流形，而非强制执行统一的时间约束。

sentences.en: Experiments show consistent improvements in temporal coherence and structural fidelity.
sentences.zh: 实验显示时间相干性与结构保真度的一致改进。

authors.name: Zhanhe Zhang
authors.institution: Xi'an University of Electronic Science and Technology

topic: General Machine Learning->Transfer, Multitask and Meta-learning
title_en: Transfer Learning in High-dimensional Ising Models
title_zh: 高维 Ising 模型中的迁移学习

sentences.en: In high-dimensional Ising model estimation, target sample sizes are often limited, and effectively using auxiliary binary datasets of unknown relevance remains challenging.
sentences.zh: 在高维 Ising 模型估计中，目标样本量往往有限，而有效利用关联未知的辅助二元数据集仍具挑战性。

sentences.en: To address this, we propose Trans-Ising, a transfer learning method that combines a loss-based source screening rule with a two-stage estimation procedure.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一点，我们提出 Trans-Ising，一种结合基于损失的源筛选规则与两阶段估计流程的迁移学习方法。

sentences.en: The method first identifies informative auxiliary sources using held-out target pseudolikelihood to prevent negative transfer.
sentences.zh: 该方法首先使用留出目标伪似然识别有信息量的辅助源，以防止负迁移。

sentences.en: It then computes an initial estimator via pooled nodewise $\ell_1$-regularized logistic regression, followed by a target-only correction step using a folded-concave penalty.
sentences.zh: 然后，它通过汇合的逐节点 $\ell_1$-正则化逻辑回归计算初始估计器，随后用折叠凹惩罚进行仅目标的修正步骤。

sentences.en: Theoretically, we establish fixed-node $\ell_2$ and $\ell_1$ error bounds, exact graph selection consistency, and the conditional consistency of the screening rule.
sentences.zh: 在理论上，我们建立固定节点 $\ell_2$ 与 $\ell_1$ 误差界、精确图选择一致性以及筛选规则的条件一致性。

sentences.en: Through extensive simulations and real-data analyses, we demonstrate that Trans-Ising achieves lower estimation errors than both target-only estimation and naive data pooling.
sentences.zh: 通过广泛模拟与真实数据分析，我们证明 Trans-Ising 比仅目标估计与朴素数据汇合都取得更低的估计误差。

topic: General Machine Learning->Transfer, Multitask and Meta-learning
title_en: Transfer Learning in Nonparametric Regression with Deep ReLU Networks
title_zh: 带深层 ReLU 网络的非参数回归中的迁移学习

sentences.en: This paper develops a general transfer learning framework for nonparametric regression with data consisting of multiple groups.
sentences.zh: 本文为包含多个组数据的非参数回归发展了一个通用迁移学习框架。

sentences.en: Under the assumption that groups share a common structure along with group-specific deviations in additive form, the proposed method employs a two-stage offset learning procedure: the first stage pools data from all groups to estimate an overall mean function, and the second stage estimates offsets for each group, yielding final group-level estimators through additive combination.
sentences.zh: 在组间共享公共结构且带有加性形式的组特异偏差这一假设下，所提出的方法采用两阶段偏移学习流程：第一阶段汇合所有组的数据以估计整体均值函数，第二阶段估计每个组的偏移量，通过加性组合产生最终的组级估计器。

sentences.en: Upper bounds on the $\mathcal L_2$ error are established for the proposed framework, covering a broad class of nonparametric estimators under mild complexity and noise conditions.
sentences.zh: 为所提出的框架确立了 $\mathcal L_2$ 误差的上界，在温和复杂度与噪声条件下涵盖了一大类非参数估计器。

sentences.en: When instantiated with deep ReLU networks, explicit convergence rates are derived under hierarchical composition models, demonstrating the ability to overcome the curse of dimensionality.
sentences.zh: 当用深层 ReLU 网络实例化时，在层级组合模型下导出显式收敛速率，展示出克服维数灾难的能力。

sentences.en: Conditions that enable positive transfer with faster rates are considered, including learning with simpler functions and data augmentation through pooling samples across groups.
sentences.zh: 考虑使正迁移得以实现、速率更快的条件，包括用更简单的函数学习以及通过跨组汇合样本进行数据增强。

sentences.en: Various simulations and real-data experiments further validate the effectiveness of the proposed method.
sentences.zh: 各种模拟与真实数据实验进一步验证了所提出方法的有效性。

authors.name: Yanzhen Chen
authors.institution: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology

title_en: Transferable Reinforcement Learning via Probabilistic Latent Embeddings and Dynamic Policy Adaptation for Sim-to-Real Deployment
title_zh: 面向 Sim-to-Real 部署的经概率潜在嵌入与动态策略适应的可迁移强化学习

sentences.en: Due to limited resources and public safety concerns, deep reinforcement learning (RL) agents for many cyber-physical systems (e.g., autonomous vehicles) are first trained in simulators.
sentences.zh: 因资源有限与公共安全考量，许多信息物理系统（例如自动驾驶车辆）的深度强化学习（RL）智能体首先在模拟器中训练。

sentences.en: However, when deployed in real world environments, they often suffer from performance degradation or safety violations because of the inevitable Sim2Real gap.
sentences.zh: 然而，部署到真实世界环境时，因不可避免的 Sim2Real 差距，它们往往遭受性能退化或安全违规。

sentences.en: Existing zero-shot approaches, such as robust safe RL and domain randomization, mitigate this issue but typically at the cost of degraded performance or residual safety risks when experiencing unmodeled system dynamics.
sentences.zh: 现有零样本方法（例如稳健安全 RL 与域随机化）缓解了这一问题，但通常以性能退化或在遭遇未建模系统动力学时的残余安全风险为代价。

sentences.en: To address these limitations, we propose a novel reinforcement learning framework that enables safe and efficient policy transfer via probabilistic latent embeddings and dynamic policy adaptation.
sentences.zh: 为应对这些局限，我们提出一个经概率潜在嵌入与动态策略适应实现安全高效策略迁移的新颖强化学习框架。

sentences.en: We consider a family of Constrained Markov Decision Processes (CMDPs) under different environment contexts.
sentences.zh: 我们考虑不同环境上下文下的一族受约束马尔可夫决策过程（CMDP）。

sentences.en: By leveraging latent context variable in meta-RL, the proposed framework infers the latent representation of the environment from simulated experiences.
sentences.zh: 通过利用元 RL 中的潜在上下文变量，所提出的框架从模拟经验中推断环境的潜在表示。

sentences.en: Furthermore, it incorporates a distributional RL formulation, which allows risk levels of the deployed policy to be adjusted dynamically, based on the estimation accuracy of the latent context variable.
sentences.zh: 此外，它纳入一个分布式 RL 表述，使得能够根据潜在上下文变量的估计精度动态调整部署策略的风险水平。

sentences.en: This strategy promotes safety at the early deployment stage and improves efficiency through fast policy adaptation under the Sim2Real gap.
sentences.zh: 该策略在部署早期促进安全性，并通过在 Sim2Real 差距下的快速策略适应提升效率。

title_en: Transform Trained Transformer for Accelerating Native 4K Video Generation
title_zh: 变换已训练 Transformer 以加速原生 4K 视频生成

sentences.en: Native 4K (2176$\times$3840) video generation remains a critical challenge due to the quadratic computational explosion of full-attention as spatiotemporal resolution increases, making it difficult for models to strike a balance between efficiency and quality.
sentences.zh: 原生 4K（2176$\times$3840）视频生成仍是一项关键挑战，因为随着时空分辨率增加，全注意力的二次方计算爆炸使模型难以在效率与质量之间取得平衡。

sentences.en: This paper proposes a novel Transformer retrofit strategy termed T3 (**T**ransform **T**rained **T**ransformer) that, without altering the core architecture of full-attention pretrained models, significantly reduces compute requirements by optimizing their forward logic.
sentences.zh: 本文提出一种新颖的 Transformer 改造策略，称为 T3（**T**ransform **T**rained **T**ransformer，变换已训练 Transformer），它在不改变全注意力预训练模型核心架构的情况下，通过优化其前向逻辑显著降低计算需求，

sentences.en: Specifically, T3-Video introduces a multi-scale weight-sharing window attention mechanism and, via hierarchical blocking together with an axis-preserving full-attention design, can effect an “attention pattern” transformation of a pretrained model using only modest compute and data.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，T3-Video 引入一种多尺度权重共享窗口注意力机制，并通过层级分块与保持轴的全注意力设计，仅用适度的计算与数据即可实现预训练模型的“注意力模式”变换。

sentences.en: Results on 4K-VBench show that T3-Video substantially outperforms existing approaches: while delivering performance improvements (+4.29$\uparrow$ VQA and +0.08$\uparrow$ VTC), it accelerates native 4K video generation by more than 10$\times$.
sentences.zh: 在 4K-VBench 上的结果表明，T3-Video 大幅优于现有方法：在带来性能改进（+4.29$\uparrow$ VQA 与 +0.08$\uparrow$ VTC）的同时，将原生 4K 视频生成加速超过 10$\times$。

sentences.en: Demo and source code are available in \#Supp.
sentences.zh: 演示与源码可在%Supp 中获取。

title_en: Transformed Latent Variable Multi-Output Gaussian Processes
title_zh: 变换潜变量多输出高斯过程

sentences.en: Multi-Output Gaussian Processes (MOGPs) provide a principled probabilistic framework for modelling correlated outputs but face scalability bottlenecks when applied to datasets with high-dimensional output spaces.
sentences.zh: 多输出高斯过程（MOGP）为建模相关输出提供了有原则的概率框架，但在应用于高维输出空间的数据集时面临可扩展性瓶颈。

sentences.en: To maintain tractability, existing methods typically resort to restrictive assumptions, such as employing low-rank or sum-of-separable kernels, which can limit expressiveness.
sentences.zh: 为保持可处理性，现有方法通常诉诸限制性假设，例如采用低秩或可分离核，这限制了表达力。

sentences.en: We propose the Transformed Latent Variable MOGP (T-LVMOGP), a novel framework that scales MOGPs to a massive number of outputs while preserving the capacity to capture meaningful inter-output dependencies.
sentences.zh: 我们提出变换潜变量 MOGP（T-LVMOGP），一个将 MOGP 扩展到海量输出数量的新颖框架，同时保持捕获有意义的输出间依赖的能力。

sentences.en: T-LVMOGP constructs a flexible multi-output deep kernel by mapping inputs and output-specific latent variables into an embedding space using a Lipschitz-regularised neural network.
sentences.zh: T-LVMOGP 通过使用 Lipschitz 正则化神经网络将输入与输出特异的潜在变量映射到嵌入空间，构建一个灵活的多输出深层核。

sentences.en: Combined with stochastic variational inference, our model effectively scales to high-dimensional output settings.
sentences.zh: 与随机变分推断结合后，我们的模型可有效扩展到高维输出设定。

sentences.en: Across diverse benchmarks, including climate modelling with over $10,000$ outputs and zero-inflated spatial transcriptomics data, T-LVMOGP outperforms baselines in both predictive accuracy and computational efficiency.
sentences.zh: 跨多样基准（包括输出超过 $10,000$ 个的气候建模与零膨胀空间转录组数据），T-LVMOGP 在预测准确率与计算效率两方面都优于基线。

title_en: Transformer Circuits Can Realize Clustering Algorithms
title_zh: Transformer 电路可实现聚类算法

sentences.en: Although transformers are most commonly optimized as statistical sequence models, it is unclear to what extent they can implement and learn exact algorithmic computations.
sentences.zh: 虽然 Transformer 最常被优化为统计序列模型，但它们能在何种程度上实现并学习精确的算法计算仍不清楚。

sentences.en: Here, we specify a transformer implementation from first principles that executes a fundamental and widely used method for $k$-means clustering: Lloyd's algorithm.
sentences.zh: 在此，我们从基本原理出发，指定一个执行 $k$-均值聚类中一种基本且广泛使用的方法——Lloyd 算法——的 Transformer 实现。

sentences.en: We theoretically prove and empirically demonstrate that this implementation of a transformer architecture, which we term the _$k$-means transformer_, exactly implements Lloyd's algorithm for $k$-means clustering using the standard circuit mechanisms of modern transformers: attention block, residual connections, and feed-forward block.
sentences.zh: 我们在理论上证明并在经验上展示，这一我们称为 _k-均值 Transformer_ 的 Transformer 架构实现，利用现代 Transformer 的标准电路机制（注意力块、残差连接与前馈块）精确实现用于 $k$-均值聚类的 Lloyd 算法。

sentences.en: In learning experiments, we find that training this base architecture on $k$-means clustering yields a generalizable clustering algorithm that surpasses Lloyd's algorithm in terms of clustering quality.
sentences.zh: 在学习实验中，我们发现在这一基础架构上训练 $k$-均值聚类会产生一个在聚类质量上超越 Lloyd 算法的可泛化聚类算法。

sentences.en: Finally, we demonstrate that interpretable alterations (e.g., inclusion of layer normalizations) to this architecture yields diverse and novel variants of clustering algorithms, including soft $k$-means, spherical $k$-means, trimmed $k$-means.
sentences.zh: 最后，我们展示对这一架构的可解释改动（例如加入层归一化）会衍生出多样且新颖的聚类算法变体，包括软 $k$-均值、球面 $k$-均值与修剪 $k$-均值。

sentences.en: Overall, our results show that transformer circuit mechanisms can instantiate exact algorithmic routines for clustering, while simultaneously providing an effective learnable model.
sentences.zh: 总体而言，我们的结果表明 Transformer 电路机制可以实例化聚类的精确算法例程，同时提供一个有效的可学习模型。

title_en: Transformers Can Learn Posterior Predictive Distributions In-Context
title_zh: Transformer 可以在上下文中学习后验预测分布

sentences.en: Prior-data fitted networks (PFNs) have recently emerged as a powerful approach for Bayesian prediction tasks, approximating the posterior predictive distribution (PPD) through in-context learning.
sentences.zh: 先验数据拟合网络（PFN）近期作为贝叶斯预测任务的强大方法而出现，通过上下文学习逼近后验预测分布（PPD）。

sentences.en: Despite their strong empirical performance and ability to go beyond point predictions, theoretical understandings of the algorithmic capability of transformers to learn distributions in context are still lacking.
sentences.zh: 尽管它们有强劲的经验性能与超越点预测的能力，但对 Transformer 在上下文中学习分布的算法能力的理论理解仍然缺乏。

sentences.en: Focusing on Gaussian process regression problems, we show by construction that transformers can implement a gradient descent algorithm targeting the posterior predictive mean and variance, followed by nonlinear mappings that yield binned probabilities of PPD.
sentences.zh: 聚焦高斯过程回归问题，我们通过构造表明 Transformer 可以实现一个针对后验预测均值与方差的目标梯度下降算法，随后是非线性映射，产生 PPD 的分箱概率。

sentences.en: We study the error bounds of the approximated PPD in terms of attention depth and bin resolution.
sentences.zh: 我们以注意力深度与分箱分辨率研究近似 PPD 的误差界。

sentences.en: Based on these results, we further demonstrate the key role of normalization and the choice of attention depth in enabling the extrapolation abilities of transformers beyond the pretraining sample size range.
sentences.zh: 基于这些结果，我们进一步证明归一化与注意力深度选择在使 Transformer 获得超越预训练样本量范围的外推能力中的关键作用。

sentences.en: We conduct simulations that corroborate our findings, providing insight into the expressivity of PFNs targeting PPDs and how architectural choices may influence generalization capabilities.
sentences.zh: 我们进行支持我们发现的模拟，为针对 PPD 的 PFN 表达力以及架构选择如何影响泛化能力提供洞见。

title_en: Transformers Efficiently Perform In-Context Logistic Regression via Normalized Gradient Descent
title_zh: Transformer 经归一化梯度下降高效执行上下文逻辑回归

sentences.en: Transformers have demonstrated remarkable in-context learning (ICL) capabilities.
sentences.zh: Transformer 已展现出非凡的上下文学习（ICL）能力。

sentences.en: The strong ICL performance of transformers is commonly believed to arise from their ability to implicitly execute certain algorithms on the context, thereby enhancing prediction and generation.
sentences.zh: Transformer 强劲的 ICL 性能通常被认为源于它们在上下文中隐式执行某些算法的能力，从而增强预测与生成。

sentences.en: In this work, we investigate how transformers with softmax attention perform in-context learning on linear classification data.
sentences.zh: 在这项工作中，我们研究带 softmax 注意力的 Transformer 如何在线性分类数据上执行上下文学习。

sentences.en: We first construct a class of multi-layer transformers that can perform in-context logistic regression, with each layer exactly performing one step of normalized gradient descent on an in-context loss.
sentences.zh: 我们首先构造一类多层 Transformer，它们可以执行上下文逻辑回归，其中每层恰好对上下文损失执行一步归一化梯度下降。

sentences.en: Then, we show that our constructed transformer can be obtained through (i) training a single self-attention layer supervised by one-step gradient descent, and (ii) recurrently applying the trained layer to obtain a looped model.
sentences.zh: 然后，我们表明所构造的 Transformer 可以通过（i）训练一个由单步梯度下降监督的自注意力层，以及（ii）循环应用训练好的层以获得循环模型来获得。

sentences.en: Training convergence guarantees of the self-attention layer and out-of-distribution generalization guarantees of the looped model are provided.
sentences.zh: 提供了自注意力层的训练收敛保证与循环模型的分布外泛化保证。

sentences.en: Our results advance the theoretical understanding of ICL mechanism by showcasing how softmax transformers can effectively act as in-context learners.
sentences.zh: 我们的结果通过展示 softmax Transformer 如何有效充当上下文学习器，推进了对 ICL 机制的理论理解。

title_en: Transformers learn factored representations
title_zh: Transformer 学习因式分解表示

sentences.en: Transformers pretrained via next token prediction learn to factor their world into parts, representing these factors in orthogonal subspaces of the residual stream.
sentences.zh: 经由下一词元预测预训练的 Transformer 学会将世界因式分解为各个部分，并在残差流的正交子空间中表示这些因子。

sentences.en: We formalize two representational hypotheses: (1) a representation in the product space of all factors, whose dimension grows exponentially with the number of parts, or (2) a factored representation in orthogonal subspaces, whose dimension grows linearly.
sentences.zh: 我们形式化两种表示假说：（1）在所有因子的乘积空间中的表示，其维度随部分数量指数增长；或（2）在正交子空间中的因式分解表示，其维度线性增长。

sentences.en: Both track context-induced uncertainty over the latent parts, but the factored representation sacrifices fidelity when factors are not conditionally independent.
sentences.zh: 两者都跟踪隐因子上的上下文诱导不确定性，但当因子不条件独立时，因式分解表示会牺牲保真度。

sentences.en: We derive precise predictions about the geometric structure of activations for each, including the number of subspaces, their dimensionality, and the arrangement of context embeddings within them.
sentences.zh: 我们为每种推导出关于激活几何结构的精确预测，包括子空间数量、其维度以及其中上下文嵌入的排列。

sentences.en: We test between these hypotheses on transformers trained on synthetic processes with known latent structure.
sentences.zh: 我们在带已知隐结构的合成过程训练的 Transformer 上检验这些假说。

sentences.en: When factors are conditionally independent, models learn factored representations; when noise or dependencies break this structure, models gradually expand their effective dimensionality over training to recover fidelity.
sentences.zh: 当因子条件独立时，模型学习因式分解表示；当噪声或依赖破坏这一结构时，模型在训练过程中逐步扩展其有效维度以恢复保真度。

sentences.en: This provides a principled explanation for why transformers decompose the world into parts, and suggests that interpretable low dimensional structure may persist even in models trained on complex data.
sentences.zh: 这为 Transformer 为何将世界分解为各部提供了有原则的解释，并表明即使在复杂数据训练的模型中，可解释的低维结构也可能持续存在。

title_en: Transformers Learn the Optimal DDPM Denoiser for Multi-Token GMMs
title_zh: Transformer 学习多词元高斯混合分布的最优 DDPM 去噪器

sentences.en: Transformer-based diffusion models have demonstrated remarkable performance at generating high-quality samples.
sentences.zh: 基于 Transformer 的扩散模型在生成高质量样本方面展现出非凡性能。

sentences.en: However, our theoretical understanding of the reasons for this success remains limited.
sentences.zh: 然而，我们对这一成功原因的理论理解仍然有限。

sentences.en: For instance, existing models are typically trained by minimizing a denoising objective, which is equivalent to fitting the score function of the training data.
sentences.zh: 例如，现有模型通常通过最小化去噪目标训练，这等价于拟合训练数据的分数函数。

sentences.en: However, we do not know why transformer-based models can match the score function for denoising, or why gradient-based methods converge to the optimal denoising model despite the non-convex loss landscape.
sentences.zh: 然而，我们不知道基于 Transformer 的模型为何能匹配去噪的分数函数，也不知道在非凸损失景观下，基于梯度的方法为何能收敛到最优去噪模型。

sentences.en: To the best of our knowledge, this paper provides the first convergence analysis for training transformer-based diffusion models.
sentences.zh: 据我们所知，本文提供了针对基于 Transformer 的扩散模型训练的首个收敛分析。

sentences.en: More specifically, we consider the population Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Model (DDPM) objective for denoising data that follow a \textit{multi-token Gaussian mixture} distribution.
sentences.zh: 更具体地说，我们考虑针对服从\textit{多词元高斯混合}分布的去噪数据的总体去噪扩散概率模型（DDPM）目标。

sentences.en: We theoretically quantify the required number of tokens per data point and training iterations for the global convergence towards the Bayes optimal risk of the denoising objective, thereby achieving a desired score matching error.
sentences.zh: 我们在理论上量化实现去噪目标贝叶斯最优风险的全局收敛所需的每数据点词元数与训练迭代次数，从而达成期望的分数匹配误差。

sentences.en: A deeper investigation reveals that the self-attention module of the trained transformer implements a \emph{mean denoising} mechanism that enables the trained model to approximate the oracle Minimum Mean Squared Error (MMSE) estimator of the injected noise in the diffusion steps.
sentences.zh: 更深入的研究揭示，训练好的 Transformer 的自注意力模块实现一种*均值去噪*机制，使训练好的模型能够逼近扩散步骤中注入噪声的 oracle 最小均方误差（MMSE）估计器。

sentences.en: Numerical experiments validate these findings.
sentences.zh: 数值实验验证了这些发现。

authors.name: Hongkang Li
authors.institution: University of Pennsylvania, University of Pennsylvania

title_en: Transformers Provably Learn Algorithmic Solutions for Graph Connectivity, But Only with the Right Data
title_zh: Transformer 可证明地学习图连通性的算法解，但只有用正确数据

sentences.en: Transformers often fail to learn generalizable algorithms, instead relying on brittle heuristics.
sentences.zh: Transformer 往往无法学习可泛化算法，转而依赖脆弱的启发式。

sentences.en: Using graph connectivity as a testbed, we explain this phenomenon both theoretically and empirically.
sentences.zh: 以图连通性为测试床，我们在理论与经验两方面解释这一现象。

sentences.en: We consider a simplified Transformer architecture, the Disentangled Transformer, and prove that an $L$-layer model can compute connectivity in graphs with diameters up to $3^L$, implementing an algorithm equivalent to computing powers of the adjacency matrix.
sentences.zh: 我们考虑一个简化的 Transformer 架构——解纠缠 Transformer，并证明一个 $L$-层模型可以计算直径至多 $3^L$ 的图的连通性，实现一个等价于计算邻接矩阵幂的算法。

sentences.en: By analyzing training dynamics, we prove that whether the model learns this strategy hinges on whether most training instances are within this model capacity.
sentences.zh: 通过分析训练动力学，我们证明模型是否习得这一策略取决于大多数训练实例是否在该模型容量内。

sentences.en: Within-capacity graphs (diameter $\leq 3^L$) drive the learning of the algorithmic solution while beyond-capacity graphs drive the learning of a simple heuristic based on node degrees.
sentences.zh: 容量内的图（直径 $\leq 3^L$）驱动算法解的习得，而容量外的图则驱动基于节点度的简单启发式的习得。

sentences.en: Finally, we empirically show that our insights transfer to standard Transformers: restricting training data to stay within a model's capacity makes both standard and Disentangled Transformers learn the exact algorithm.
sentences.zh: 最后，我们在经验上表明我们的洞见可迁移到标准 Transformer：将训练数据限制在模型容量内，使标准与解纠缠 Transformer 都能习得精确算法。

title_en: Transformers with RL or SFT Provably Learn Sparse Boolean Functions, But Differently
title_zh: 带 RL 或 SFT 的 Transformer 可证明地学习稀疏布尔函数，但方式不同

sentences.en: Transformers can acquire Chain-of-Thought (CoT) capabilities to solve reasoning tasks via fine-tuning.
sentences.zh: Transformer 可以通过微调获得思维链（CoT）能力来解决推理任务。

sentences.en: Reinforcement learning (RL) and supervised fine-tuning (SFT) are two primary approaches to this end.
sentences.zh: 强化学习（RL）与监督微调（SFT）是实现这一目标的两种主要方法。

sentences.en: In this work, we examine RL with verifiable process rewards and SFT for learning $k$-sparse Boolean functions with a one-layer transformer through intermediate reasoning steps akin to CoT.
sentences.zh: 在这项工作中，我们考察带可验证过程奖励的 RL 与 SFT，用一层 Transformer 通过类似 CoT 的中间推理步骤学习 $k$-稀疏布尔函数。

sentences.en: In particular, we consider Boolean functions that can be recursively decomposed into fixed 2-sparse Boolean functions.
sentences.zh: 特别地，我们考虑可递归分解为固定 2-稀疏布尔函数的布尔函数。

sentences.en: We first analyze the learning dynamics of RL fine-tuning with verifiable process rewards and SFT in a unified way, allowing us to identify sufficient conditions under which the transformer provably learns these functions.
sentences.zh: 我们首先以统一方式分析带可验证过程奖励的 RL 微调与 SFT 的学习动力学，使我们能够识别 Transformer 可证明习得这些函数的充分条件。

sentences.en: We then verify that these conditions hold for three basic examples, including $k$-PARITY, $k$-AND, and $k$-OR, thus demonstrating their learnability via both RL and SFT.
sentences.zh: 然后，我们验证这些条件对三个基本示例成立，包括 $k$-PARITY、$k$-AND 与 $k$-OR，从而证明它们经 RL 与 SFT 的可学习性。

sentences.en: Notably, we reveal that RL and SFT exhibit distinct learning behaviors: RL learns the whole CoT chain simultaneously, whereas SFT learns the CoT step-by-step.
sentences.zh: 值得注意的是，我们揭示 RL 与 SFT 表现出不同的学习行为：RL 同时学习整条 CoT 链，而 SFT 逐步学习 CoT。

sentences.en: Overall, our findings provide insights on the mechanisms underlying RL and SFT and how they differ in triggering the CoT capabilities of transformers, and suggest that the comparison between RL and SFT may need to consider the reward design and the use of teacher forcing.
sentences.zh: 总体而言，我们的发现为 RL 与 SFT 的底层机制以及它们在触发 Transformer CoT 能力上的差异提供洞见，并表明 RL 与 SFT 的比较可能需要考虑奖励设计与教师强迫的使用。

title_en: Transforming Weather Data from Pixel to Latent Space
title_zh: 将天气数据从像素空间变换到潜在空间

sentences.en: The increasing impact of climate change and extreme weather events has spurred growing interest in deep learning for weather research.
sentences.zh: 气候变化与极端天气事件日益加剧的影响，激起了对天气研究中深度学习的兴趣。

sentences.en: However, existing studies often rely on weather data in pixel space, which presents several challenges such as smooth outputs in model outputs, limited applicability to a single pressure-variable subset (PVS), and high data storage and computational costs.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有研究往往依赖像素空间的天气数据，这带来若干挑战，例如模型输出的平滑伪影、对单一压力-变量子集（PVS）的有限适用性，以及高昂的数据存储与计算成本。

sentences.en: To address these challenges, we propose a novel Weather Latent Autoencoder (WLA) that transforms weather data from pixel space to latent space, enabling efficient data representation.
sentences.zh: 为应对这些挑战，我们提出一种新颖的天气潜在自编码器（WLA），它将天气数据从像素空间变换到潜在空间，实现高效的数据表示。

sentences.en: By decoupling weather reconstruction from downstream tasks, WLA improves the accuracy and sharpness of weather task model results.
sentences.zh: 通过将天气重建与下游任务解耦，WLA 提升了天气任务模型的准确率与锐利度。

sentences.en: The incorporated Pressure-Variable Unified Module transforms multiple PVS into a unified representation, enhancing the adaptability of the model in multiple weather scenarios.
sentences.zh: 纳入的压力-变量统一模块将多个 PVS 转换为统一表示，增强了模型在多种天气场景中的适应性。

sentences.en: Furthermore, weather tasks can be performed in a low-storage latent space of WLA rather than a high-storage pixel space, thus significantly reducing data storage and computational costs.
sentences.zh: 此外，天气任务可以在 WLA 的低存储潜在空间而非高存储像素空间中执行，从而显著降低数据存储与计算成本。

sentences.en: Through extensive experimentation, we demonstrate its superior compression and reconstruction performance, enabling the creation of the ERA5-Latent dataset with unified representations of multiple PVS from ERA5 data.
sentences.zh: 通过广泛实验，我们展示了其优越的压缩与重建性能，能够创建带多种 PVS 统一表示的 ERA5-Latent 数据集。

sentences.en: The compressed full PVS in the ERA5-Latent dataset reduces the original 244.34 TB of data to 0.43 TB.
sentences.zh: ERA5-Latent 数据集中压缩的完整 PVS 将原始 244.34 TB 的数据缩减至 0.43 TB。

sentences.en: The downstream task further demonstrates that task models can apply to multiple PVS with low data costs in latent space and achieve superior performance compared to models in pixel space.
sentences.zh: 下游任务进一步表明，任务模型可以以低数据成本在潜在空间应用于多个 PVS，并取得优于像素空间模型的性能。

authors.institution: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology

title_en: Transitive Representation Learning Enhances Histopathology Annotation
title_zh: 传递表示学习增强组织病理学标注

sentences.en: The characterization of histopathology with AI promises to assist clinical decision-making, but it is currently limited due to coarse-grained annotations that miss cellular identities.
sentences.zh: 用 AI 刻画组织病理学有望辅助临床决策，但目前因缺乏识别细胞身份的粗粒度标注而受限。

sentences.en: To overcome this gap, we bridge histopathological images, gene expression profiles, and natural-language descriptions using *SpatialWhisperer*, a trimodal contrastive learning model.
sentences.zh: 为弥合这一差距，我们用 *SpatialWhisperer*——一个三模态对比学习模型——桥接组织病理图像、基因表达谱与自然语言描述。

sentences.en: Our training integrates community-scale datasets comprising spatially resolved gene expression profiles paired with histopathology images, as well as single-cell gene expression profiles with detailed annotations.
sentences.zh: 我们的训练整合了社区规模的数据集，包括与组织病理图像配对的空间分辨基因表达谱，以及带详细标注的单细胞基因表达谱。

sentences.en: The shared gene expression modality implies a transitive relationship between images and textual annotations, which our method leverages to enable accurate zero-shot cell type annotation directly from H&E images.
sentences.zh: 共享的基因表达模态意味着图像与文本标注之间存在传递关系，我们的方法利用这一关系实现直接从 H&E 图像出发的准确零样本细胞类型标注。

sentences.en: *SpatialWhisperer* outperforms published baselines, achieving relative AUROC gains of up to 15.9% across three benchmarks spanning 19 tissues and 20 cell types.
sentences.zh: *SpatialWhisperer* 优于已发表的基线，在覆盖 19 种组织与 20 种细胞类型的三个基准上取得最高达 15.9% 的相对 AUROC 增益。

sentences.en: When training with data from all three modality pairs, we observe performance gains in low-data regimes.
sentences.zh: 当用全部三个模态对的数据训练时，我们观察到低数据体制下的性能增益。

sentences.en: We formalize our approach and present a sufficient condition under which this transitive alignment is induced.
sentences.zh: 我们将我们的方法形式化，并给出诱导该传递对齐的一个充分条件。

sentences.en: Our work establishes *transitive representation learning* for fine-grained interpretation of histopathology images.
sentences.zh: 我们的工作确立了面向组织病理图像细粒度解释的*传递表示学习*。

title_en: Transitivity Meets Cyclicity: Explicit Preference Decomposition for Dynamic Large Language Model Alignment
title_zh: 传递性邂逅循环性：面向动态大语言模型对齐的显式偏好分解

sentences.en: Standard RLHF relies on transitive scalar rewards, failing to capture the cyclic nature of human preferences.
sentences.zh: 标准 RLHF 依赖传递的标量奖励，未能捕捉人类偏好的循环性质。

sentences.en: While some approaches like the General Preference Model (GPM) address this, we identify a theoretical limitation: their implicit formulation entangles hierarchy with cyclicity, failing to guarantee dominant solutions.
sentences.zh: 虽然一些方法（如 General Preference Model，GPM）解决了这一点，我们识别出一个理论局限：它们的隐式表述将层级性与循环性纠缠在一起，无法保证支配解。

sentences.en: To address this, we propose the Hybrid Reward-Cyclic (HRC) model, which utilizes game-theoretic decomposition to explicitly disentangle preferences into orthogonal transitive (scalar) and cyclic (vector) components.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一点，我们提出混合奖励-循环（HRC）模型，它利用博弈论分解将偏好显式解缠为相互正交的传递（标量）与循环（向量）分量。

sentences.en: Complementing this, we introduce Dynamic Self-Play Preference Optimization (DSPPO), which treats alignment as a time-varying game to progressively guide the policy toward the Nash equilibrium.
sentences.zh: 作为补充，我们引入动态自博弈偏好优化（DSPPO），它将对齐视为随时间变化的博弈，以渐进地将策略导向纳什均衡。

sentences.en: Synthetic data experiments further validate HRC's structural superiority in mixed transitive--cyclic settings, where HRC converges faster and achieves higher accuracy than GPM.
sentences.zh: 合成数据实验进一步验证了 HRC 在混合传递-循环设定中的结构优越性，其中 HRC 收敛更快，准确率高于 GPM。

sentences.en: Experiments on RewardBench 2 demonstrate that HRC consistently improves over both BT and GPM baselines (e.g., +1.23\% on Gemma-2B-it).
sentences.zh: 在 RewardBench 2 上的实验表明，HRC 相对 BT 与 GPM 基线持续改进（例如在 Gemma-2B-it 上 +1.23\%）。

sentences.en: In particular, its superior performance in the Ties domain empirically validates the model's robustness in handling complex, non-strict preferences.
sentences.zh: 特别地，它在 Ties 领域的优越表现从经验上验证了模型在处理复杂、非严格偏好时的鲁棒性。

sentences.en: Extensive downstream evaluations on AlpacaEval 2.0, Arena-Hard-v0.1, and MT-Bench confirm the efficacy of our framework.
sentences.zh: 在 AlpacaEval 2.0、Arena-Hard-v0.1 与 MT-Bench 上的大量下游评估证实了我们框架的有效性。

sentences.en: Notably, when using Gemma-2B-it as the base preference model, HRC+DSPPO achieves a peak length-controlled win-rate of 44.75\% on AlpacaEval 2.0 and 46.8\% on Arena-Hard-v0.1, significantly outperforming SPPO baselines trained with BT or GPM.
sentences.zh: 值得注意的是，当用 Gemma-2B-it 作为基础偏好模型时，HRC+DSPPO 在 AlpacaEval 2.0 上取得 44.75\% 的峰值长度受控胜率，在 Arena-Hard-v0.1 上取得 46.8\%，显著优于用 BT 或 GPM 训练的 SPPO 基线。

sentences.en: Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/lab-klc/Hybrid-Reward-Cyclic.
sentences.zh: 我们的代码公开于 https://github.com/lab-klc/Hybrid-Reward-Cyclic。

title_en: Translation Heads: Disentangling meaning from language in LLM-based machine translation
title_zh: 翻译头：基于 LLM 的机器翻译中意义与语言的解缠

sentences.en: Mechanistic Interpretability (MI) seeks to explain how neural networks implement their capabilities, but the scale of Large Language Models (LLMs) has limited prior MI work in Machine Translation (MT) to word-level analyses.
sentences.zh: 可机械解释性（MI）旨在解释神经网络如何实现其能力，但大语言模型（LLM）的规模使此前机器翻译（MT）中的 MI 工作局限于词级分析。

sentences.en: We study sentence-level MT from a mechanistic perspective by analyzing attention heads to understand how LLMs internally encode and distribute translation functions.
sentences.zh: 我们从机制视角研究句级 MT，通过分析注意力头理解 LLM 如何内部编码与分布翻译函数。

sentences.en: We decompose MT into two subtasks: producing text in the target language (i.e. target language identification) and preserving the input sentence’s meaning (i.e. sentence equivalence).
sentences.zh: 我们将 MT 分解为两个子任务：生成目标语言文本（即目标语言识别）与保持输入句子的意义（即句子等价）。

sentences.en: Across three families of open-source models and 20 translation directions, we find that distinct, sparse sets of attention heads specialize in each subtask.
sentences.zh: 跨三个开源模型家族与 20 个翻译方向，我们发现不同且稀疏的注意力头集合各自擅长一个子任务。

sentences.en: Based on this insight, we construct subtask-specific steering vectors and show that modifying just 1% of the relevant heads enables instruction-free MT performance comparable to instruction-based prompting, while ablating these heads selectively disrupts their corresponding translation functions.
sentences.zh: 基于这一洞见，我们构造子任务特异的引导向量并表明，仅修改 1% 的相关头即可实现与基于指令的提示相当的无指令 MT 性能，而消融这些头会选择性地破坏它们对应的翻译函数。

title_en: TransLight: Image-Guided Customized Lighting Control with Generative Decoupling
title_zh: TransLight：带生成解耦的图像引导定制光照控制

sentences.en: Most existing illumination-editing methods struggle to jointly offer customized lighting control and preserve content integrity, limiting their effectiveness especially in transferring complex light effects from a reference to a target image in portrait photography.
sentences.zh: 大多数现有光照编辑方法难以同时提供定制光照控制与保持内容完整性，这限制了它们的有效性，尤其在将复杂光照效果从参考图迁移到人像摄影目标图方面。

sentences.en: To address this problem, we propose TransLight, a novel framework that enables high-fidelity and high-freedom transfer of geometric-structured light effects such as Tyndall beams and specular highlights.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一问题，我们提出 TransLight，一个能够以高保真与高自由度迁移几何结构光照效果（如丁达尔光束与镜面高光）的新颖框架。

sentences.en: Extracting light effects from the reference image is the most critical and challenging step, as real-world lighting contains complex geometric structures tightly coupled with image content.
sentences.zh: 从参考图中提取光照效果是最关键且最具挑战性的步骤，因为真实光照包含与图像内容紧密耦合的复杂几何结构。

sentences.en: To achieve this, we propose Generative Decoupling, using two fine-tuned diffusion models to accurately separate image content and lighting, and create a new million-scale dataset of image–content–light triplets.
sentences.zh: 为实现这一点，我们提出生成解耦，用两个微调扩散模型精确分离图像内容与光照，并创建一个新的百万规模 image-content-light 三元组数据集。

sentences.en: We then adopt IC-Light as the generative model, training it on these triplets with the reference lighting image as an additional conditioning signal.
sentences.zh: 然后我们采用 IC-Light 作为生成模型，以参考光照图像作为额外的条件信号对这些三元组进行训练。

sentences.en: The resulting model enables customized and natural transfer of diverse light effects.
sentences.zh: 所得模型能够实现多样光照效果的定制化与自然迁移。

sentences.en: Notably, by fully disentangling light effects from reference images, our generative decoupling strategy gives TransLight highly flexible illumination control.
sentences.zh: 值得注意的是，通过从参考图像中完全解缠光照效果，我们的生成解耦策略赋予 TransLight 高度灵活的光照控制。

sentences.en: Experiments show that TransLight successfully transfers geometric-structured lighting effects across diverse images in portrait photography, offering more customized control than existing methods and charting new directions in illumination harmonization and editing.
sentences.zh: 实验表明，TransLight 成功地跨人像摄影中的多样图像迁移几何结构光照效果，相比现有方法提供更定制化的控制，并在光照和谐化与编辑方面开辟了新方向。

sentences.en: Our project page is hustvl.github.io/TransLight.
sentences.zh: 我们的项目页面：hustvl.github.io/TransLight。

title_en: TransNormal: Dense Visual Semantics for Diffusion-based Transparent Object Normal Estimation
title_zh: TransNormal：用于基于扩散的透明物体法向估计的稠密视觉语义

sentences.en: Monocular normal estimation for transparent objects is critical for laboratory automation, yet it remains challenging due to complex light refraction and reflection.
sentences.zh: 透明物体的单目法向估计对实验室自动化至关重要，但因复杂的光折射与反射，它仍具挑战性。

sentences.en: These optical properties often lead to catastrophic failures in conventional depth and normal sensors, hindering the deployment of embodied AI in scientific environments.
sentences.zh: 这些光学特性往往导致传统深度与法向传感器灾难性失效，阻碍具身 AI 在科学环境中的部署。

sentences.en: We propose **TransNormal**, a novel framework that adapts pre-trained diffusion priors for single-step normal regression.
sentences.zh: 我们提出 **TransNormal**，一个将预训练扩散先验适配到单步法向回归的新颖框架。

sentences.en: To handle the lack of texture in transparent surfaces, TransNormal integrates dense visual semantics from DINOv3 via a cross-attention mechanism, providing strong geometric cues.
sentences.zh: 为应对透明表面缺乏纹理的问题，TransNormal 通过交叉注意力机制整合来自 DINOv3 的稠密视觉语义，提供强几何线索。

sentences.en: Furthermore, we employ a multi-task learning objective and wavelet-based regularization to ensure the preservation of fine-grained structural details.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们采用多任务学习目标与基于小波的正则化，以确保细粒度结构细节的保持。

sentences.en: To support this task, we introduce **TransNormal-Synthetic**, a physics-based dataset with high-fidelity normal maps for transparent labware.
sentences.zh: 为支持这一任务，我们引入 **TransNormal-Synthetic**，一个带透明实验室器皿高保真法向图的基于物理的数据集。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate that TransNormal significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods: on the ClearGrasp benchmark, it reduces mean error by 25.5\% and improves the best prior $11.25^\circ$ accuracy by 24.7\%; on ClearPose, it achieves a 17.7\% reduction in mean error.
sentences.zh: 广泛实验表明 TransNormal 显著优于最先进方法：在 ClearGrasp 基准上，它平均误差降低 25.5\%，将此前最优的 $11.25^\circ$ 准确率提升 24.7\%；在 ClearPose 上，平均误差降低 17.7\%。

sentences.en: Code and dataset are publicly available at https://github.com/longxiang-ai/TransNormal.
sentences.zh: 代码与数据集公开于 https://github.com/longxiang-ai/TransNormal。

title_en: Transolver-3: Scaling Up Transformer Solvers to Industrial-Scale Geometries
title_zh: Transolver-3：将 Transformer 求解器扩展到工业规模几何

sentences.en: Deep learning has emerged as a transformative tool for the neural surrogate modeling of partial differential equations (PDEs), known as neural PDE solvers.
sentences.zh: 深度学习已成为偏微分方程（PDE）神经代理建模（即神经 PDE 求解器）的变革性工具。

sentences.en: However, scaling these solvers to industrial-scale geometries with over $10^8$ cells remains a fundamental challenge due to the prohibitive memory complexity of processing high-resolution meshes.
sentences.zh: 然而，将这些求解器扩展到单元数超过 $10^8$ 的工业规模几何仍是根本性挑战，因为处理高分辨率网格的内存复杂度令人望而却步。

sentences.en: We present Transolver-3, a new member of the Transolver family as a highly scalable framework designed for high-fidelity physics simulations.
sentences.zh: 我们提出 Transolver-3，Transolver 家族的新成员，一个为高保真物理模拟设计的高度可扩展框架。

sentences.en: To bridge the gap between limited GPU capacity and the resolution requirements of complex engineering tasks, we introduce two key architectural optimizations:  faster slice and deslice by exploiting matrix multiplication associative property and geometry slice tiling to partition the computation of physical states.
sentences.zh: 为弥合有限 GPU 容量与复杂工程任务分辨率要求之间的差距，我们引入两个关键的架构优化：通过利用矩阵乘法结合律加快切片与逆切片，以及通过几何切片平铺划分物理状态的计算。

sentences.en: Combined with an amortized training strategy by learning on random subsets of original high-resolution meshes and a physical state caching technique during inference, Transolver-3 enables high-fidelity field prediction on industrial-scale meshes.
sentences.zh: 结合摊销训练策略（在原始高分辨率网格的随机子集上学习）与推理期间的物理状态缓存技术，Transolver-3 能够在工业规模网格上实现高保真场预测。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate that Transolver-3 can handle meshes with over 160 million cells, achieving impressive performance across three challenging simulation benchmarks, including aircraft and automotive design tasks.
sentences.zh: 广泛实验表明，Transolver-3 可以处理超过 1.6 亿单元的网格，在三个具挑战性的模拟基准（包括飞机与汽车设计任务）上取得出色性能。

sentences.en: Code is available at https://github.com/thuml/Transolver-3.
sentences.zh: 代码见 https://github.com/thuml/Transolver-3。

title_en: Transport and Merge: Cross-Architecture Merging for Large Language Models
title_zh: 运输与合并：面向大语言模型的跨架构合并

sentences.en: Large language models (LLMs) achieve strong capabilities by scaling model capacity and training data, yet many real-world deployments rely on smaller models trained or adapted from low-resource data.
sentences.zh: 大语言模型（LLM）通过扩展模型容量与训练数据达到强大能力，但许多真实世界部署依赖从低资源数据训练或适配的较小模型。

sentences.en: This gap motivates the need for mechanisms to transfer knowledge from large, high-resource models to smaller, low-resource targets.
sentences.zh: 这一差距促使需要将知识从大型高资源模型转移到较小低资源目标的机制。

sentences.en: While model merging provides an effective transfer mechanism, most existing approaches assume architecture-compatible models and therefore cannot directly transfer knowledge from large high-resource LLMs to heterogeneous low-resource targets.
sentences.zh: 虽然模型合并提供了有效的迁移机制，但大多数现有方法假设架构兼容的模型，因此无法直接将知识从大型高资源 LLM 转移到异构低资源目标。

sentences.en: In this work, we propose a cross-architecture merging framework based on optimal transport (OT) that aligns activations to infer cross-neuron correspondences between heterogeneous models.
sentences.zh: 在这项工作中，我们提出一个基于最优运输（OT）的跨架构合并框架，它对齐激活以推断异构模型之间的跨神经元对应关系。

sentences.en: The resulting transport plans are then used to guide direct weight-space fusion, enabling effective high-resource to low-resource transfer using only a small set of inputs.
sentences.zh: 所得的运输计划随后用于指导直接权重空间融合，仅用一小组输入即可实现高效的高资源到低资源迁移。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments across low-resource languages and specialized domains demonstrate consistent improvements over target models.
sentences.zh: 跨低资源语言与专业领域的广泛实验表明相对目标模型的一致改进。

title_en: Transport Clustering: Solving Low-Rank Optimal Transport via Clustering
title_zh: 运输聚类：通过聚类求解低秩最优运输

sentences.en: Optimal transport (OT) finds a least-cost transport plan between two probability distributions.
sentences.zh: 最优运输（OT）在两个概率分布之间寻找最小代价的运输计划。

sentences.en: Unlike standard OT, which infers unstructured pointwise mappings, low-rank optimal transport explicitly constrains the rank of the transport plan to infer latent structure.
sentences.zh: 与推断无结构逐点映射的标准 OT 不同，低秩最优运输显式约束运输计划的秩以推断潜在结构。

sentences.en: This improves statistical robustness, yields sharper parametric rates for estimating Wasserstein distances, and generalizes $K$-means to co-clustering.
sentences.zh: 这提升了统计鲁棒性，为估计 Wasserstein 距离带来更尖锐的参数速率，并将 $K$-均值推广到协同聚类。

sentences.en: However, these advantages come at the cost of a non-convex and NP-hard optimization problem.
sentences.zh: 然而，这些优势以非凸且 NP 困难的优化问题为代价。

sentences.en: We introduce Transport Clustering, an algorithm to compute a low-rank OT plan that reduces low-rank OT to a clustering problem on correspondences obtained from a full-rank transport registration step.
sentences.zh: 我们引入运输聚类，一个计算低秩 OT 计划的算法，它将低秩 OT 归约为在全秩运输配准步骤获得的对应关系上的聚类问题。

sentences.en: We prove that this reduction yields polynomial-time, constant-factor approximation algorithms for low-rank OT: specifically, a $(1+\gamma)$ approximation for negative-type metrics, a $(1+\gamma+\sqrt{2\gamma}\,)$ approximation for kernel costs, and a $(1+\gamma+\rho)$ approximation for general metrics satisfying the triangle inequality.
sentences.zh: 我们证明这一归约得到低秩 OT 的多项式时间常数因子近似算法：具体地，对负类度量有 $(1+\gamma)$ 近似，对核代价有 $(1+\gamma+\sqrt{2\gamma}\,)$ 近似，对满足三角不等式的一般度量有 $(1+\gamma+\rho)$ 近似。

sentences.en: Here, $\gamma \in [0,1]$ is the cost  ratio of the optimal full-rank to low-rank solutions, and $\rho\in[0,1]$ is an asymmetry coefficient on the cluster variances.
sentences.zh: 这里，$\gamma \in [0,1]$ 是最优全秩与低秩解的成本比，$\rho\in[0,1]$ 是簇方差不对称系数。

sentences.en: Numerically, Transport Clustering outperforms existing solvers on synthetic benchmarks and large-scale datasets.
sentences.zh: 在数值上，运输聚类在合成基准与大规模数据集上优于现有求解器。

title_en: Transport or Discard: Robust Unbalanced Optimal Transport for Cross-Domain Policy Adaptation
title_zh: 运输或丢弃：用于跨域策略适应的鲁棒不平衡最优运输

sentences.en: Cross-domain offline reinforcement learning leverages a source dataset to improve policy learning in a data-scarce target domain, but dynamics mismatch makes many source transitions kinematically infeasible and can cause negative transfer.
sentences.zh: 跨域离线强化学习利用源数据集改进数据稀缺目标域中的策略学习，但动力学不匹配使许多源转移在运动学上不可行，并可能导致负迁移。

sentences.en: Recent non-parametric geometric methods (e.g., standard optimal transport and k-nearest neighbors) avoid overfitting yet often yield only relative rankings under an implicit matching or retrieval budget, making performance sensitive to hand-tuned thresholds when the true cross-domain overlap is unknown.
sentences.zh: 近来的非参数几何方法（例如标准最优运输与 k 近邻）避免了过拟合，但往往只在隐式匹配或检索预算下产生相对排序，当真实跨域重叠未知时，使性能对人工调的阈值敏感。

sentences.en: We formulate availability estimation as soft subset selection by learning a source reweighting that geometrically aligns with the target.
sentences.zh: 我们通过学习一个在几何上与目标对齐的源加权重，将可用性估计形式化为软子集选择。

sentences.en: We propose **R**obust **O**ffline unbalanced **O**ptimal **T**ransport (ROOT): (i) a robust ambiguity set for uncertainty under limited target samples, and (ii) an unbalanced transport objective that penalizes mass deviation, enabling a principled transport-or-discard mechanism.
sentences.zh: 我们提出 **R**obust **O**ffline unbalanced **O**ptimal **T**ransport（ROOT，鲁棒离线不平衡最优运输）：（i）针对有限目标样本下不确定性的鲁棒模糊集，以及（ii）惩罚质量偏离的不平衡运输目标，实现有原则的运输或丢弃机制。

sentences.en: ROOT thus down-weights or discards high-cost source samples rather than forcing them onto the target support.
sentences.zh: 因此 ROOT 会降低或丢弃高成本源样本，而非把它们强行压到目标支撑上。

sentences.en: Moreover, the induced weights decay exponentially with transport cost, guaranteeing outlier suppression.
sentences.zh: 此外，诱导权重随运输成本指数衰减，保证异常值抑制。

sentences.en: On D4RL dynamics-shift benchmarks, ROOT improves downstream offline RL and outperforms strong baselines on most tasks without task-specific threshold tuning.
sentences.zh: 在 D4RL 动力学偏移基准上，ROOT 改进下游离线 RL，并在大多数任务上击败强基线，而无需任务特的阈值调参。

topic: General Machine Learning->Transfer, Multitask and Meta-learning
title_en: Transporting Task Vectors across Different Architectures without Training
title_zh: 无需训练地将任务向量在不同架构间迁移

sentences.en: Adapting large pre-trained models to downstream tasks often produces task-specific parameter updates that are expensive to relearn for every model variant.
sentences.zh: 将大型预训练模型适配到下游任务往往产生任务特异的参数更新，为每个模型变体重学这些更新代价高昂。

sentences.en: While recent work has shown that such updates can be transferred between models with identical architectures, transferring them across models of different widths remains unexplored.
sentences.zh: 虽然近来工作表明这类更新可以在架构相同的模型之间迁移，但跨不同宽度的模型迁移它们仍未被探索。

sentences.en: In this work, we introduce Theseus, a training-free method for transporting task updates across heterogeneous-width models.
sentences.zh: 在这项工作中，我们引入 Theseus，一种用于跨异宽度模型迁移任务更新的免训练方法。

sentences.en: Rather than matching parameters, we characterize a task update by the functional effect it induces on intermediate representations.
sentences.zh: 我们不对齐参数，而是通过任务更新对中间表示诱导的功能效应来刻画它。

sentences.en: We formalize task-vector transport as a functional matching problem on observed activations and show that, after aligning representation spaces via orthogonal Procrustes analysis, it admits a stable closed-form solution that preserves the geometry of the update.
sentences.zh: 我们将任务向量迁移形式化为观测激活上的功能匹配问题，并表明在对齐表示空间（经正交 Procrustes 分析）之后，它有一个保持更新几何性质的稳定闭式解。

sentences.en: We evaluate Theseus on vision and language models across different widths, showing consistent improvements over baselines without additional training or backpropagation.
sentences.zh: 我们在不同宽度的视觉与语言模型上评估 Theseus，显示在无需额外训练或反向传播的情况下相对基线的一致改进。

sentences.en: Our results show that task updates can be meaningfully transferred across architectures when task identity is defined functionally rather than parametrically.
sentences.zh: 我们的结果表明，当任务身份以功能而非参数方式定义时，任务更新可以跨架构有意义地迁移。

sentences.en: Code is available at https://github.com/apanariello4/merge-and-rebase.
sentences.zh: 代码见 https://github.com/apanariello4/merge-and-rebase。

title_en: TranX-Adapter: Bridging Artifacts and Semantics within MLLMs for Robust AI-generated Image Detection
title_zh: TranX-Adapter：在 MLLM 内桥接伪影与语义以实现鲁棒的 AI 生成图像检测

sentences.en: Rapid advances in AI-generated image (AIGI) technology enable highly realistic synthesis, threatening public information integrity and security.
sentences.zh: AI 生成图像（AIGI）技术的快速进步使其能实现高度真实的合成，威胁公共信息完整性与安全。

sentences.en: Recent studies have demonstrated that incorporating texture-level artifact features alongside semantic features into multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can enhance their AIGI detection capability.
sentences.zh: 近期研究表明，将纹理级伪影特征与语义特征一起纳入多模态大语言模型（MLLM）可以增强它们的 AIGI 检测能力。

sentences.en: However, our preliminary analyses reveal that artifact features exhibit high intra-feature similarity, leading to an almost uniform attention map after the softmax operation.
sentences.zh: 然而，我们的初步分析揭示，伪影特征表现出很高的特征内相似性，导致 softmax 操作后注意力图几乎均匀。

sentences.en: This phenomenon causes attention dilution, thereby hindering effective fusion between semantic and artifact features.
sentences.zh: 这一现象造成注意力稀释，从而阻碍语义特征与伪影特征之间的有效融合。

sentences.en: To overcome this limitation, we propose a lightweight fusion adapter, TranX-Adapter, which integrates a Task-aware Optimal-Transport Fusion that leverages the Jensen-Shannon divergence between artifact and semantic prediction probabilities as a cost matrix to transfer artifact information into semantic features, and an X-Fusion that employs cross-attention to transfer semantic information into artifact features.
sentences.zh: 为克服这一局限，我们提出一个轻量级融合适配器 TranX-Adapter，它整合了任务感知最优运输融合（利用伪影与语义预测概率之间的 Jensen-Shannon 散度作为代价矩阵，将伪影信息转移到语义特征中）与 X-Fusion（用交叉注意力将语义信息转移到伪影特征中）。

sentences.en: Experiments on standard AIGI detection benchmarks upon several advanced MLLMs, show that our TranX-Adapter brings consistent and significant improvements (up to +6% accuracy).
sentences.zh: 在多个先进 MLLM 上的标准 AIGI 检测基准实验中表明，我们的 TranX-Adapter 带来一致且显著的改进（最高 +6% 准确率）。

sentences.en: Code can be found in supplementary material.
sentences.zh: 代码见补充材料。

title_en: TRAP: Hijacking VLA CoT-Reasoning via Adversarial Patches
title_zh: TRAP：通过对抗补丁劫持 VLA 的 CoT 推理

sentences.en: By integrating Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning, Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have demonstrated strong capabilities in robotic manipulation, particularly by improving generalization and interpretability.
sentences.zh: 通过整合思维链（CoT）推理，视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在机器人操作中展现出强大能力，尤其改善了泛化性与可解释性。

sentences.en: However, the security of CoT-based reasoning mechanisms remains largely unexplored.
sentences.zh: 然而，基于 CoT 的推理机制的安全性在很大程度上仍未被探索。

sentences.en: In this paper, we show that CoT reasoning introduces a novel attack vector for targeted behavior hijacking—for example, causing a robot to mistakenly deliver a knife to a person instead of an apple—without modifying the user’s instruction.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们表明 CoT 推理为针对性行为劫持引入了一个新攻击向量——例如，在不修改用户指令的情况下，使机器人误将刀而非苹果递给一个人。

sentences.en: We first provide empirical evidence that CoT strongly governs action generation, even when it is semantically misaligned with the input instructions.
sentences.zh: 我们首先提供经验证据表明，即使 CoT 与输入指令在语义上不对齐，它也强烈支配动作生成。

sentences.en: Building on this observation, we propose **TRAP**, the first targeted behavior-hijacking adversarial attack against CoT-reasoning VLA models.
sentences.zh: 基于这一观察，我们提出 **TRAP**，第一个针对 CoT 推理 VLA 模型的针对性行为劫持对抗攻击。

sentences.en: By targeting the reasoning-to-action pathway, **TRAP** uses an adversarial patch (*e.g.*, a tablecloth placed on the table) to steer intermediate CoT reasoning and downstream actions toward adversary-defined behaviors.
sentences.zh: 通过针对推理到动作的通路，**TRAP** 使用对抗补丁（*例如*，放在桌上的桌布）将被劫持的中间 CoT 推理与后续动作导向攻击者定义的行为。

sentences.en: Extensive evaluations on three representative reasoning VLAs, spanning distinct CoT reasoning mechanisms, demonstrate the effectiveness of **TRAP**.
sentences.zh: 在三个代表性推理 VLA 上涵盖不同 CoT 推理机制的广泛评估，展示了 **TRAP** 的有效性。

sentences.en: Notably, we implemented the patch by printing it on paper in a real-world setting.
sentences.zh: 值得注意的是，我们在真实场景中将补丁打印在纸上进行了实现。

sentences.en: Our findings highlight the urgent need to secure CoT reasoning in VLA systems.
sentences.zh: 我们的发现凸显了保护 VLA 系统中 CoT 推理安全的迫切需求。

sentences.en: The project page is available at https://zhengxian-huang.github.io/TRAP-website/.
sentences.zh: 项目页面见 https://zhengxian-huang.github.io/TRAP-website/。

title_en: Treatment Responder Classification with Abstention
title_zh: 带弃权的治疗响应者分类

sentences.en: Treatment responder classification seeks to learn a rule to classify individuals who will benefit from the treatment.
sentences.zh: 治疗响应者分类旨在学习一个规则，对将从治疗中受益的个体进行分类。

sentences.en: This paper studies a new scenario in treatment responder classification when abstention is allowed, i.e., practitioners can opt out of making uncertain classification on some individuals for further investigation.
sentences.zh: 本文研究了治疗响应者分类中允许弃权的一个新场景，即从业者可以选择不对某些个体做不确定的分类，待进一步调查。

sentences.en: By revealing the implicit relation between causal misclassification risk with abstention and Conditional Value at Risk (CVaR), we develop a doubly robust method named TRECA to learn the classification rule under loose convergence conditions on nuisance parameters, and further extend it to deal with possible violation on key assumptions such as monotonicity and unconfoundedness.
sentences.zh: 通过揭示带弃权的因果误分类风险与条件风险值（CVaR）之间的隐式关系，我们开发了一个被称为 TRECA 的双稳健方法，在关于干扰参数的宽松收敛条件下学习分类规则，并进一步将其扩展到应对单调性与无混淆性等关键假设可能的违反。

sentences.en: Rigorous theories and extensive experiments on two real-world datasets demonstrate the theoretical and experimental guarantee on our methods in learning treatment responders classification rules with low regret at the cost of limited abstention.
sentences.zh: 严谨的理论与在两个真实数据集上的大量实验，证明了我们方法以有限弃权代价学习具有低遗憾的治疗响应者分类规则的理论与实验保证。

title_en: Tree-Structured Orthonormal Decomposition of the Aitchison Simplex
title_zh: Aitchison 单形的树结构正交分解

sentences.en: Compositional data---vectors encoding relative proportions---arise across scientific domains, including ecology, geochemistry, and genomics.
sentences.zh: 成分数据——编码相对比例的向量——出现在从生态学、地球化学到基因组学的众多科学领域。

sentences.en: The features in these data often come with known hierarchical structure (e.g., taxonomies, phylogenies, ontologies), yet existing methods either ignore this structure, discard the intrinsic Aitchison geometry, are designed for binary trees, or yield incomplete coordinate systems.
sentences.zh: 这些数据中的特征往往带有已知的层级结构（例如分类树、系统发育树、本体），但现有方法要么忽略这一结构，要么丢弃内在的 Aitchison 几何，要么专为二叉树设计，要么产生不完整的坐标系。

sentences.en: We describe *PolyILR*, a canonical orthonormal decomposition of the Aitchison tangent space aligned with any tree topology.
sentences.zh: 我们描述 *PolyILR*，一个与任意树拓扑对齐的 Aitchison 切空间规范正交分解。

sentences.en: Our construction defines a weighted local geometry at each internal node capturing full branching structure, then lifts these to a global orthonormal basis where every coordinate corresponds to a specific tree location.
sentences.zh: 我们的构造在每个内部节点定义一个捕获完整分支结构的加权局部几何，然后将它们提升到一个全局正交基，其中每个坐标对应一个具体的树位置。

sentences.en: On microbiome and single-cell benchmarks, PolyILR yields stable, interpretable features and enables inference at multiscale tree resolution.
sentences.zh: 在微生物组与单细胞基准上，PolyILR 产生稳定、可解释的特征，并在多尺度树分辨率下实现推断。

sentences.en: We also establish a novel theoretical connection to softmax classifiers, suggesting possible applications to probabilistic modeling.
sentences.zh: 我们还建立了一个与 softmax 分类器的新颖理论联系，提示了在概率建模中的可能应用。

title_en: TreeCUA: Efficiently Scaling GUI Automation with Tree-Structured Verifiable Evolution
title_zh: TreeCUA：用树结构可验证演化高效扩展 GUI 自动化

sentences.en: Effectively scaling GUI automation is essential for computer-use agents (CUAs); however, existing work primarily focuses on scaling GUI grounding rather than the more crucial GUI planning, which requires more sophisticated data collection.
sentences.zh: 有效扩展 GUI 自动化对计算机使用智能体（CUA）至关重要；然而，现有工作主要聚焦扩展 GUI 定位而非更关键的 GUI 规划，后者需要更复杂的数据收集。

sentences.en: In reality, the exploration process of a CUA across apps/desktops/web pages typically follows a tree structure, with earlier functional entry points often being explored more frequently.
sentences.zh: 实际上，CUA 跨应用/桌面/网页的探索过程通常遵循树结构，较早的功能入口往往被更频繁地探索。

sentences.en: In this work, we find that organizing large-scale GUI trajectories into tree structures can effectively eliminate redundant exploration costs, while each branch node also provides key reasoning evidence for distinguishing adjacent trajectories.
sentences.zh: 在这项工作中，我们发现将大规模 GUI 轨迹组织成树结构可以有效消除冗余探索开销，同时每个分支节点还为区分相邻轨迹提供关键推理证据。

sentences.en: Therefore, we propose TreeCUA to efficiently scale GUI automation with tree-structured verifiable evolution.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们提出 TreeCUA，用树结构可验证演化高效扩展 GUI 自动化。

sentences.en: We propose a multi-agent collaborative framework to explore the environment, verify actions, summarize trajectories, and evaluate quality to generate high-quality and scalable GUI trajectories.
sentences.zh: 我们提出一个多智能体协作框架，探索环境、验证动作、总结轨迹并评估质量，以生成高质量且可扩展的 GUI 轨迹。

sentences.en: To improve efficiency, we devise a novel tree-based topology to store and replay duplicate exploration nodes, and design an adaptive exploration algorithm to balance the depth (i.e., trajectory difficulty) and breadth (i.e., trajectory diversity).
sentences.zh: 为提高效率，我们设计了一种新颖的基于树的拓扑来存储与重放重复的探索节点，并设计自适应探索算法以平衡深度（即轨迹难度）与广度（即轨迹多样性）。

sentences.en: Moreover, we develop world knowledge guidance and global memory backtracking to avoid low-quality generation.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们开发了世界知识引导与全局记忆回溯，以避免低质量生成。

sentences.en: Finally, we naturally extend and propose the TreeCUA-DPO method from abundant tree node information, improving GUI planning capability by referring to the branch information of adjacent trajectories.
sentences.zh: 最后，我们从丰富的树节点信息中自然地扩展并提出 TreeCUA-DPO 方法，通过参考相邻轨迹的分支信息改进 GUI 规划能力。

sentences.en: Experimental results show that TreeCUA and TreeCUA-DPO offer significant improvements, and out-of-domain (OOD) studies further demonstrate strong generalization.
sentences.zh: 实验结果表明，TreeCUA 与 TreeCUA-DPO 提供显著改进，且域外（OOD）研究进一步展示了强泛化性。

sentences.en: All trajectory node information and code will be open-sourced.
sentences.zh: 所有轨迹节点信息与代码将开源。
