title_en: TreePO: Enhancing Policy Efficacy and Inference Efficiency with Tree Modeling
title_zh: TreePO：用树建模增强策略效能与推理效率

sentences.en: Recent advancements in aligning large language models via reinforcement learning have achieved remarkable gains in solving complex reasoning problems, but at the cost of expensive on-policy rollouts and limited exploration of diverse reasoning paths.
sentences.zh: 近来经强化学习对齐大语言模型的进展在解决复杂推理问题方面取得了显著成绩，但代价是昂贵的在线策略回滚与对多样推理路径的有限探索。

sentences.en: In this work, we introduce TreePO, involving a self-guided rollout algorithm that views sequence generation as a tree-structured searching process.
sentences.zh: 在这项工作中，我们引入 TreePO，它包含一个自引导回滚算法，将序列生成视为树结构搜索过程。

sentences.en: Composed of dynamic tree sampling policy and fixed-length segment decoding, TreePO leverages local uncertainty to warrant additional branches.
sentences.zh: 由动态树采样策略与固定长度分段解码组成，TreePO 利用局部不确定性来保证额外的分支。

sentences.en: By amortizing computation across common prefixes and pruning low-value paths early, TreePO essentially reduces the per-update compute burden while preserving or enhancing exploration diversity.
sentences.zh: 通过在公共前缀间分摊计算并早期剪枝低价值路径，TreePO 实质上降低了每次更新的计算负担，同时保持或增强了探索多样性。

sentences.en: Key contributions include: (1) a segment-wise sampling algorithm that alleviates the KV cache burden through contiguous segments and spawns new branches along with an early-stop mechanism; (2) a tree-based segment-level advantage estimation that considers both global and local proximal policy optimization. and (3) analysis on the effectiveness of probability and quality-driven dynamic divergence and fallback strategy.
sentences.zh: 关键贡献包括：（1）一个分段采样算法，通过连续段缓解 KV 缓存负担，并在带早停机制的同时生成新分支；（2）一个考虑全局与局部近端策略优化的基于树的段级优势估计；（3）对概率与质量驱动动态发散及回退策略有效性的分析。

sentences.en: We empirically validate the performance gain of TreePO on a set reasoning benchmarks and the efficiency saving of GPU hours from 22% up to 43% of the sampling design for the trained models, meanwhile showing up to 40% reduction at trajectory-level and 35% at token-level sampling compute for the existing models.
sentences.zh: 我们在若干推理基准上实证验证了 TreePO 的性能增益，并将训练模型采样设计的 GPU 时数节省从 22% 提升至 43%，同时表明对现有模型在轨迹级采样计算上最多减少 40%、在词元级最多减少 35%。

sentences.en: While offering a free lunch of inference efficiency, TreePO reveals a practical path toward scaling RL-based post-training with fewer samples and less compute.
sentences.zh: 在提供推理效率“免费午餐”的同时，TreePO 揭示了用更少样本与更少计算扩展基于 RL 的后训练的一条实用路径。

title_en: Trees to Flows and Back: Unifying Decision Trees and Diffusion Models
title_zh: 从树到流再返回：统一决策树与扩散模型

sentences.en: Decision trees and diffusion models are ostensibly disparate model classes, one discrete and hierarchical, the other continuous and dynamic.
sentences.zh: 决策树与扩散模型表面上是截然不同的模型类别，一个是离散层级的，另一个是连续动态的。

sentences.en: This work unifies the two by establishing a crisp mathematical correspondence between hierarchical decision trees and diffusion processes in appropriate limiting regimes.
sentences.zh: 这项工作通过在适当的极限体制下建立层级决策树与扩散过程之间精确的数学对应，将两者统一起来。

sentences.en: Our unification reveals a shared optimization principle: \emph{Global Trajectory Score Matching (GTSM)}, for which gradient boosting (in an idealized version) is asymptotically optimal.
sentences.zh: 我们的统一揭示了一个共享的优化原则：\emph{全局轨迹分数匹配（GTSM）}，对此而言（理想化版本的）梯度提升是渐近最优的。

sentences.en: We underscore the conceptual value of our work through two key practical instantiations: treeflow, which achieves competitive  generation quality on tabular data with higher fidelity and a 2× computational  speedup, and dsmtree, a novel distillation method that transfers hierarchical  decision logic into neural networks, matching teacher performance within 2\% on many benchmarks.
sentences.zh: 我们通过两个关键的实用实例强调我们工作的概念价值：treeflow，它在表格数据上以更高保真度取得有竞争力的生成质量且带来 2× 计算加速；以及 dsmtree，一种新颖的蒸馏方法，将层级决策逻辑转移进神经网络，在许多基准上达到 2\% 以内的教师性能。

title_en: Tri-Scale Neural ODEs for Continuous Multi-Omics Disease Modeling
title_zh: 用于连续多组学疾病建模的三尺度神经 ODE

sentences.en: The fields of AI-based disease fingerprinting, drug discovery and repurposing are currently among the emerging frontiers of machine learning applied to medicine.
sentences.zh: 基于 AI 的疾病指纹识别、药物发现与再定位领域目前是机器学习应用于医学中的新兴前沿之一。

sentences.en: One major challenge is to obtain robust $\textit{in-silico}$ modeling of disease progression while accounting for the vastly different time scales of biochemical interactions, from gene expression to protein abundance and metabolic flux.
sentences.zh: 一个主要挑战是获得鲁棒的 $\textit{在计算机中}$ 疾病进展建模，同时考虑生化相互作用的巨大时间尺度差异，从基因表达、蛋白质丰度到代谢通量。

sentences.en: Discrete sequence models inadequately represent such multi-scale interactions, and standard Neural Ordinary Differential Equations (NODEs) often fail to train stably under stiffness (different time scales).
sentences.zh: 离散序列模型难以充分表示这种多尺度相互作用，而标准神经常微分方程（NODE）在刚性问题（不同时间尺度）下往往无法稳定训练。

sentences.en: To address this, a Tri-Scale Stiff NODE, defined by hierarchically coupled latent differential equations that model the causal relationships from genes to proteins and metabolites, is introduced and optimized in this paper in terms of reconstruction error and information-theoretic mutual information.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一点，本文引入并优化了一个三尺度刚性 NODE，它由层级耦合的隐微分方程定义，对从基因到蛋白质与代谢物的因果关系建模，并在重建误差与信息论互信息方面进行优化。

sentences.en: This enables continuous-time modeling of cellular responses to identify not only the disease dynamics, but also drug perturbations that act within narrow time windows, often invisible to discrete-time approaches.
sentences.zh: 这实现了对细胞响应的连续时间建模，不仅能识别疾病动力学，还能识别在狭窄时间窗内起作用的药物扰动——这些扰动往往对离散时间方法不可见。

sentences.en: Lyapunov analysis provides a theoretical guarantee that the modeled trajectories remain stable and well-behaved even under extreme stiffness.
sentences.zh: Lyapunov 分析提供了一个理论保证，即即使在极端刚性问题下，所建模的轨迹也保持稳定且表现良好。

sentences.en: The methodology is validated using the STATegra B-cell and Traxler macrophage datasets, with the former utilized for a proof-of-concept drug repurposing pipeline.
sentences.zh: 该方法用 STATegra B 细胞与 Traxler 巨噬细胞数据集验证，前者用于概念验证的药物再定位流程。

title_en: Triadic Dynamics Aware Diffusion Posterior Sampling for Inverse Problems: Optimizing Guidance and Stochasticity Schedules
title_zh: 面向逆问题的三元动力学感知扩散后验采样：优化引导与随机性调度

sentences.en: Generative posterior sampling using diffusion models has emerged as a dominant paradigm for solving inverse problems in imaging, which usually consists of three main components: data consistency (DC) guidance, classifier-free guidance (CFG) and stochasticity.
sentences.zh: 用扩散模型的生成式后验采样已成为求解成像逆问题的主导范式，它通常由三个主要组件组成：数据一致性（DC）引导、无分类器引导（CFG）与随机性。

sentences.en: While prior arts have focused on how to develop each or all components, less attention has given to how to schedule them, leading to heuristically fixed or partially adjusted suboptimal schedules.
sentences.zh: 虽然先前研究聚焦于如何开发每个或全部组件，但对如何调度它们的关注较少，导致启发式固定或部分调整的次优调度。

sentences.en: In this work, we argue that the interactions among all three components in terms of scheduling are crucial for significantly improved performance in solving inverse problems in imaging.
sentences.zh: 在这项工作中，我们认为所有三个组件在调度方面的相互作用对显著改进成像逆问题求解性能至关重要。

sentences.en: Our analysis shows that aggressive CFG early in sampling conflict with DC guidance, while stochasticity brings the trajectory back to higher-probability regions.
sentences.zh: 我们的分析表明，采样早期激进的 CFG 与 DC 引导冲突，而随机性将轨迹带回更高概率的区域。

sentences.en: Based on these findings, we propose Triadic Dynamics Aware Posterior Sampling (TriPS), which reformulates posterior sampling as a time-varying control problem and optimizes schedules following a triadic trend of decreasing DC and stochasticity scales alongside increasing CFG scale.
sentences.zh: 基于这些发现，我们提出三元动力学感知后验采样（TriPS），它将后验采样重构为一个时变控制问题，并遵循递减 DC 与随机性尺度同时递增 CFG 尺度的三元趋势优化调度。

sentences.en: TriPS achieves this through two strategies: template-based search over functional priors for reliable baseline schedules, and Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO)-based reinforcement learning for more flexible temporal curves.
sentences.zh: TriPS 通过两个策略实现这一点：在功能先验上进行基于模板的搜索以获得可靠的基线调度，以及基于组相对策略优化（GRPO）的强化学习以获得更灵活的时变曲线。

sentences.en: Experiments demonstrate TriPS outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in data fidelity and perceptual realism.
sentences.zh: 实验表明 TriPS 在数据保真度与感知真实度上优于最先进基线。

title_en: TriAttention: Efficient Long Reasoning with Trigonometric KV Compression
title_zh: TriAttention：用三角函数 KV 压缩实现高效长程推理

sentences.en: Extended reasoning in large language models (LLMs) requires long and accurate decoding and creates severe KV cache memory bottlenecks.
sentences.zh: 大语言模型（LLM）中的扩展推理需要长而准确的解码，并造成严重的 KV 缓存内存瓶颈。

sentences.en: Leading KV cache compression methods estimate KV importance using attention scores from recent post-RoPE queries.
sentences.zh: 领先的 KV 缓存压缩方法用来自近期 RoPE 后查询的注意力分数估计 KV 重要性。

sentences.en: However, queries rotate with position during RoPE, making representative queries very few, leading to poor top-key selection and unstable reasoning.
sentences.zh: 然而，查询在 RoPE 期间随位置旋转，使有代表性的查询极少，导致关键 top-key 选择不佳且推理不稳定。

sentences.en: To avoid this issue, we turn to the pre-RoPE space, where we observe that Q and K vectors are highly concentrated around fixed non-zero centers and remain stable across positions—*Q/K concentration*.
sentences.zh: 为避免这一问题，我们转向 pre-RoPE 空间，在其中观察到 Q 与 K 向量高度集中在固定非零中心附近并跨位置保持稳定——*Q/K 集中性*。

sentences.en: We show that this concentration causes queries to preferentially attend to keys at specific distances (e.g., nearest keys), with the centers determining which distances are preferred via a trigonometric series.
sentences.zh: 我们表明这种集中性使查询倾向于注意特定距离的键（例如最近的键），其中中心通过三角函数级数决定偏爱哪些距离。

sentences.en: Based on this, we propose TriAttention to estimate key importance by leveraging these centers.
sentences.zh: 基于此，我们提出 TriAttention，利用这些中心估计键的重要性。

sentences.en: Via the trigonometric series, we use the distance preference characterized by these centers to score keys according to their positions, and also leverage Q/K norms as an additional signal for importance estimation.
sentences.zh: 通过三角函数级数，我们用这些中心刻画的距离偏好按位置对键评分，并利用 Q/K 范数作为重要性估计的额外信号。

sentences.en: On AIME25 with 32K-token generation, TriAttention matches Full Attention reasoning accuracy while achieving 2.5× higher throughput or 10.7× KV memory reduction, whereas leading baselines achieve only about half the accuracy at the same efficiency.
sentences.zh: 在带 32K 词元生成的 AIME25 上，TriAttention 在匹配全注意力推理准确率的同时实现 2.5× 更高的吞吐量或 10.7× 的 KV 内存缩减，而领先基线在相同效率下仅达到约一半的准确率。

title_en: TriForces: Augmenting Atomistic GNNs for Transferable Representations
title_zh: TriForces：为可迁移表示增强原子级 GNN

sentences.en: Machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) achieve excellent accuracy when trained on large Density Functional Theory (DFT) data.
sentences.zh: 机器学习原子间势（MLIP）在大型密度泛函理论（DFT）数据上训练时达到出色准确率。

sentences.en: To be useful in practice, they must often be adapted to target chemistries using small and expensive task-specific datasets.
sentences.zh: 要在实践中发挥作用，它们往往需要用小型且昂贵、任务特异的数据集适配到目标化学体系。

sentences.en: However, MLIPs transfer inconsistently across domains, with representations that often loose accessible composition and structure information.
sentences.zh: 然而，MLIP 跨域的迁移不一致，其表示往往丢失可访问的组成与结构信息。

sentences.en: To address this, we present TriForces, a model-agnostic three-stream framework that separates composition and structure information, combined with self-supervised learning to preserve transferable representations.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一点，我们提出 TriForces，一个模型无关的三流框架，分离组成与结构信息，并结合自监督学习以保持可迁移表示。

sentences.en: TriForces improves performance on MatBench and QM9 over baselines without needing DFT labels and enables efficient similar structure retrieval through its learned latent space.
sentences.zh: TriForces 在无需 DFT 标签的情况下，在 MatBench 与 QM9 上相对基线改进性能，并通过其习得的潜在空间实现高效的相似结构检索。

sentences.en: On OMat24, in limited-data training regime, TriForces reduces energy MAE by 57\% at 20K samples only and improves force MAE across sample sizes.
sentences.zh: 在 OMat24 上，在有限数据训练体制下，TriForces 仅用 20K 样本即将能量 MAE 降低 57\%，并跨样本量改进力 MAE。

sentences.en: We release pretrained TriForces variants across multiple MLIP architectures with code at https:/github.com/Ramlaoui/triforces.
sentences.zh: 我们在多个 MLIP 架构上发布预训练 TriForces 变体，代码见 https:/github.com/Ramlaoui/triforces。

authors.name: Hannah Bull
authors.institution: Ecole Nationale des Ponts et Chausees

title_en: Trifuse: Enhancing Attention-Based GUI Grounding via Multimodal Fusion
title_zh: Trifuse：经多模态融合增强基于注意力的 GUI 定位

sentences.en: GUI grounding maps natural language instructions to the correct interface elements, serving as the perception foundation for GUI agents.
sentences.zh: GUI 定位将自然语言指令映射到正确的界面元素，充当 GUI 智能体的感知基础。

sentences.en: Existing approaches predominantly rely on fine-tuning multimodal large language models (MLLMs) using large-scale GUI datasets to predict target element coordinates, which is data-intensive and generalizes poorly to unseen interfaces.
sentences.zh: 现有方法主要依赖用大规模 GUI 数据集微调多模态大语言模型（MLLM）来预测目标元素坐标，这数据密集且对未见界面泛化不佳。

sentences.en: Recent attention-based alternatives exploit localization signals in MLLMs attention mechanisms without task-specific fine-tuning, but suffer from low reliability due to the lack of explicit and complementary spatial anchors in GUI images.
sentences.zh: 近来基于注意力的替代方案利用 MLLM 注意力机制中的定位信号而无需任务特异微调，但因 GUI 图像缺乏显式且互补的空间锚点而可靠性低。

sentences.en: To address this limitation, we propose Trifuse, an attention-based grounding framework that explicitly integrates complementary spatial anchors.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一局限，我们提出 Trifuse，一个显式整合互补空间锚点的基于注意力定位框架。

sentences.en: Trifuse integrates attention, OCR-derived textual cues, and icon-level caption semantics via a Consensus-SinglePeak (CS) fusion strategy that enforces cross-modal agreement while retaining sharp localization peaks.
sentences.zh: Trifuse 通过 Consensus-SinglePeak（CS）融合策略整合注意力、OCR 派生的文本线索与图标级标题语义，该策略在保持锐利定位峰的同时强制跨模态一致。

sentences.en: Extensive evaluations on four grounding benchmarks demonstrate that Trifuse achieves strong performance without task-specific fine-tuning, substantially reducing the reliance on expensive annotated data.
sentences.zh: 在四个定位基准上的广泛评估表明，Trifuse 无需任务特异微调即可取得强劲性能，大幅降低对昂贵标注数据的依赖。

sentences.en: Moreover, ablation studies reveal that incorporating OCR and caption cues consistently improves attention-based grounding performance across different backbones, highlighting its effectiveness as a general framework for GUI grounding.
sentences.zh: 此外，消融研究揭示，纳入 OCR 与标题线索在不同骨干上一致地改进基于注意力的定位性能，凸显其作为 GUI 定位通用框架的有效性。

title_en: TRIM: Token-wise Attention-Derived Saliency for Data-Efficient Instruction Tuning
title_zh: TRIM：面向数据高效指令微调的词元级注意力派生态显著度

sentences.en: Instruction tuning is essential for aligning large language models (LLMs) to downstream tasks and commonly relies on large, diverse corpora.
sentences.zh: 指令微调对于将大语言模型（LLM）对齐到下游任务至关重要，通常依赖大规模、多样化的语料库。

sentences.en: However, small, high-quality subsets, known as coresets, can deliver comparable or superior results, though curating them remains challenging.
sentences.zh: 然而，被称为核集的小型高质量子集可以带来相当或更优的结果，尽管策展它们仍具挑战性。

sentences.en: Existing methods often rely on coarse, sample-level signals like gradients, an approach that is computationally expensive and overlooks fine-grained features.
sentences.zh: 现有方法往往依赖梯度等粗糙的样本级信号，这种方法计算昂贵且忽视细粒度特征。

sentences.en: To address this, we introduce TRIM (Token Relevance via Interpretable Multi-layer Attention), a forward-only, token-centric framework.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一点，我们引入 TRIM（Token Relevance via Interpretable Multi-layer Attention，经可解释多层注意力的词元相关性），一个仅前向、以词元为中心的框架。

sentences.en: Instead of using gradients, TRIM operates by matching underlying representational patterns identified via attention-based "fingerprints" from a handful of target samples.
sentences.zh: TRIM 不使用梯度，而是通过匹配由来自一小批目标样本的注意力“指纹”识别出的底层表示模式来运作。

sentences.en: Such an approach makes TRIM highly efficient and uniquely sensitive to the structural features that define a task.
sentences.zh: 这种方法使 TRIM 高效且对定义任务的结构特征特别敏感。

sentences.en: Coresets selected by our method consistently outperform state-of-the-art baselines by up to 9% on downstream tasks and even surpass the performance of full-data fine-tuning in some settings.
sentences.zh: 我们方法选择的核集在下游任务上一致超越最先进基线最高达 9%，并在一些设定中甚至超过全数据微调的性能。

sentences.en: By avoiding expensive backward passes, TRIM achieves this at a fraction of the computational cost.
sentences.zh: 通过避免昂贵的反向传播，TRIM 以计算成本的一小部分实现这一点。

sentences.en: These findings establish TRIM as a scalable and efficient alternative for building high-quality instruction-tuning datasets.
sentences.zh: 这些发现确立 TRIM 为构建高质量指令微调数据集的可扩展且高效的替代方案。

title_en: TRIP-Bench: A Benchmark for Long-Horizon Interactive Agents in Real-World Scenarios
title_zh: TRIP-Bench：面向真实世界场景中长期交互智能体的基准

sentences.en: As LLM-based agents are deployed in increasingly complex real-world settings, existing benchmarks underrepresent key challenges such as enforcing global constraints, coordinating multi-tool reasoning, and adapting to evolving user behavior over long, multi-turn interactions.
sentences.zh: 随着基于 LLM 的智能体被部署到日益复杂的真实世界环境中，现有基准低估了诸如强制全局约束、协调多工具推理以及在长时间多轮交互中适应演化用户行为等关键挑战。

sentences.en: To bridge this gap, we introduce \textbf{TRIP-Bench}, a long-horizon benchmark grounded in realistic travel-planning scenarios.
sentences.zh: 为弥合这一差距，我们引入 \textbf{TRIP-Bench}，一个基于真实旅行规划场景的长期基准。

sentences.en: TRIP-Bench leverages real-world data, offers 18 curated tools and 40+ travel requirements, and supports automated evaluation.
sentences.zh: TRIP-Bench 利用真实世界数据，提供 18 个策划工具与 40+ 项旅行需求，并支持自动化评估。

sentences.en: It includes splits of varying difficulty; the hard split emphasizes long and ambiguous interactions, style shifts, feasibility changes, and iterative version revision.
sentences.zh: 它包含难度各异的划分；困难划分强调长而模糊的交互、风格转移、可行性变化与迭代式版本修订。

sentences.en: Dialogues span up to 15 user turns, can involve 150+ tool calls, and may exceed 200k tokens of context.
sentences.zh: 对话长达 15 轮用户回合，可涉及 150+ 次工具调用，并可能超过 200k 词元的上下文。

sentences.en: Experiments show that even advanced models achieve at most 50\% success on the easy split, with performance dropping below 10\% on hard subsets.
sentences.zh: 实验表明，即使是先进模型在简单划分上的成功率也至多为 50\%，在困难子集上性能跌至 10\% 以下。

sentences.en: We further propose GTPO, an online multi-turn reinforcement learning method with specialized reward normalization and reward differencing.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步提出 GTPO，一种在线的多轮强化学习方法，带专门的奖励归一化与奖励差分。

sentences.en: Applied to Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct, GTPO improves constraint satisfaction and interaction robustness, outperforming Gemini-3-Pro in our evaluation.
sentences.zh: 应用于 Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct 后，GTPO 改进了约束满足与交互鲁棒性，在我们的评估中优于 Gemini-3-Pro。

sentences.en: We expect TRIP-Bench to advance practical long-horizon interactive agents, and GTPO to provide an effective online RL recipe for robust long-horizon training.
sentences.zh: 我们期望 TRIP-Bench 推进实用的长期交互智能体，并期望 GTPO 为鲁棒长期训练提供有效的在线 RL 配方。

title_en: TritonGym: A Benchmark for Agentic LLM Workflows in Triton GPU Code Generation
title_zh: TritonGym：面向 Triton GPU 代码生成中智能体 LLM 工作流的基准

sentences.en: Large language models (LLMs) can already draft plausible Triton kernels, yet most existing evaluations still focus on single-shot generation and underplay tool use and feedback.
sentences.zh: 大语言模型（LLM）已能起草合理的 Triton 内核，但大多数现有评估仍聚焦单次生成，低估了工具使用与反馈。

sentences.en: We introduce *TritonGym*, a benchmark and orchestration framework for evaluating agentic workflows in GPU code generation.
sentences.zh: 我们引入 *TritonGym*，一个用于评估 GPU 代码生成中智能体工作流的基准与编排框架。

sentences.en: *TritonGym* standardizes access to a set of code generation tools via function-calls, separating intrinsic model capability from workflow design and enabling fair, apples-to-apples comparison.
sentences.zh: *TritonGym* 通过函数调用标准化对一组代码生成工具的访问，将固有模型能力与工作流设计分离，实现公平的同类比较。

sentences.en: The benchmark spans a maintained operator set, community samples, out-of-distribution tasks, and DSL extensions, ensuring both generality and extensibility.
sentences.zh: 该基准涵盖一个持续维护的操作符集合、社区样例、分布外任务与 DSL 扩展，保证通用性与可扩展性。

sentences.en: By providing a common orchestration and evaluation framework, *TritonGym* democratizes the development of GPU coding agents, supports practical adoption of agent-generated kernels, and facilitates progress on advanced agentic systems.
sentences.zh: 通过提供公共的编排与评估框架，*TritonGym* 使 GPU 编码智能体的开发民主化，支持智能体生成内核的实际采用，并促进先进智能体系统的进展。

title_en: Trojan-Speak: Bypassing Constitutional Classifiers with No Jailbreak Tax via Adversarial Finetuning
title_zh: 特洛伊话语：经对抗微调无越狱代价地绕过宪制分类器

sentences.en: Fine-tuning APIs offered by major AI providers create new attack surfaces where adversaries can bypass safety measures through targeted fine-tuning.
sentences.zh: 主要 AI 提供商提供的微调 API 创造了新的攻击面，使对手可以通过有针对性的微调绕过安全措施。

sentences.en: We introduce **Trojan-Speak**, an adversarial fine-tuning method that bypasses Anthropic's Constitutional Classifiers.
sentences.zh: 我们引入 **Trojan-Speak**，一种绕过 Anthropic 宪制分类器的对抗微调方法。

sentences.en: Our approach uses curriculum learning combined with GRPO-based hybrid reinforcement learning to teach models a communication protocol that evades LLM-based content classification.
sentences.zh: 我们的方法结合课程学习与基于 GRPO 的混合强化学习，教会模型一种逃避基于 LLM 的内容分类的通信协议。

sentences.en: Crucially, while prior adversarial fine-tuning approaches report more than 25\% capability degradation on reasoning benchmarks, Trojan-Speak incurs less than 5\% degradation while achieving 99+\% classifier evasion for models with 14B+ parameters.
sentences.zh: 关键在于，先前对抗微调方法在推理基准上报告的能力退化超过 25\%，而 Trojan-Speak 在实现 99+\% 分类器规避（针对 14B+ 参数模型）的同时，退化低于 5\%。

sentences.en: We demonstrate that fine-tuned models can provide detailed responses to expert-level CBRN (Chemical, Biological, Radiological, and Nuclear) queries from Anthropic's Constitutional Classifiers bug-bounty program.
sentences.zh: 我们表明，微调模型可以为来自 Anthropic 宪制分类器漏洞赏金计划的专家级 CBRN（化学、生物、放射与核）查询提供详细回答。

sentences.en: Our findings reveal that LLM-based content classifiers alone are insufficient for preventing dangerous information disclosure when adversaries have fine-tuning access, and we show that activation-level probes can substantially improve robustness to such attacks.
sentences.zh: 我们的发现揭示，当对手拥有微调访问权时，仅靠基于 LLM 的内容分类器不足以防止危险信息披露，并且我们表明激活级探针可以显著提高对此类攻击的鲁棒性。

authors.name: Xuanli He
authors.institution: University College London, University of London

title_en: Trust Functions: Near Lossless Weak-to-Strong Generalization by Learning to Trust the Weak Teacher
title_zh: 信任函数：通过学习信任弱教师实现近乎无损的弱到强泛化

sentences.en: Weak-to-strong generalization studies how to improve a strong student using supervision from a weaker teacher when reliable labels are scarce.
sentences.zh: 弱到强泛化研究如何在可靠标签稀缺时，用较弱教师的监督改进较强学生。

sentences.en: We view this primarily as a data selection problem, where the key challenge is to identify which weak labels are reliable enough to serve as a training signal.
sentences.zh: 我们主要将其视为一个数据选择问题，其中关键挑战是识别哪些弱标签足够可靠，可作训练信号。

sentences.en: To address this, we introduce trust functions that assign each weak label a scalar trust score and use these scores to filter weak supervision.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一点，我们引入信任函数，为每个弱标签分配一个标量信任分数，并用这些分数过滤弱监督。

sentences.en: Across several domains, including world knowledge, quantitative reasoning, decision making, trust filtering yields students that match and sometimes surpass ground-truth supervision, achieving near-lossless weak-to-strong generalization.
sentences.zh: 跨世界知识、定量推理、决策制定等多个领域，信任过滤产生的学生匹配、有时超越真值监督，实现近乎无损的弱到强泛化。

sentences.en: Moreover, trust functions enable an iterative weak-to-strong chain that compounds gains by training a student and reusing it as the next teacher, producing the strongest final model.
sentences.zh: 此外，信任函数实现了一个迭代的弱到强链条，通过训练一个学生并复用它作为下一教师来累积增益，产生最强的最终模型。

sentences.en: Our analyses suggest that neural trust functions improve learning through more than label error reduction.
sentences.zh: 我们的分析表明，神经信任函数通过超越标签误差减少的方式改进学习。

sentences.en: They induce an implicit easy-first curriculum, recover near-optimal alternatives where ground truth labels are incomplete, and produce more coherent gradient updates, offering a mechanistic account of the stability and efficiency of trust-filtered weak-to-strong generalization.
sentences.zh: 它们诱导一个隐式的由易到难课程，在真值标签不完整时恢复近乎最优的替代方案，并产生更连贯的梯度更新，为信任过滤的弱到强泛化的稳定性与效率提供了机制层面的解释。

title_en: Trust It or Not: Evidential Uncertainty for Feed-Forward 3D Reconstruction with Trust3R
title_zh: 信不信由你：用 Trust3R 实现前馈 3D 重建的证据不确定性

sentences.en: Geometric foundation models hold promise for unconstrained dense geometry prediction from uncalibrated images.
sentences.zh: 几何基础模型有望实现从未标定图像进行无约束稠密几何预测。

sentences.en: However, current feed-forward designs often produce heuristic confidence scores that lack probabilistic interpretation and fail to indicate where and how much the predicted geometry can be trusted.
sentences.zh: 然而，当前的前馈设计往往产生缺乏概率解释的启发式置信分数，无法指示预测几何在何处、多大程度上可以被信任。

sentences.en: To address this gap, we present ***Trust3R***, a lightweight evidential uncertainty framework for feed-forward 3D reconstruction.
sentences.zh: 为弥合这一差距，我们提出 ***Trust3R***，一个用于前馈 3D 重建的轻量级证据不确定性框架。

sentences.en: Trust3R combines gated residual mean refinement with a Normal-Inverse-Wishart evidential head, yielding a closed-form multivariate Student-t distribution for per-point geometric uncertainty.
sentences.zh: Trust3R 将门控残差均值细化与 Normal-Inverse-Wishart 证据头结合，为逐点几何不确定性产生闭式多变量 Student-t 分布。

sentences.en: This provides probabilistically grounded pointmap uncertainty estimates with moderate inference overhead.
sentences.zh: 这提供了具有概率依据的点图不确定性估计，推理开销适中。

sentences.en: We evaluate on diverse indoor and outdoor benchmarks and compare against  MASt3R's built-in confidence map, single-pass heteroscedastic regression, MC dropout, and deep ensembles.
sentences.zh: 我们在多样的室内外基准上评估，并与 MASt3R 的内置置信图、单次异方差回归、MC dropout 与深度集成比较。

sentences.en: Experimental results show that Trust3R consistently improves risk--coverage and sparsification, generally improves geometric accuracy, and strengthens uncertainty ranking across benchmarks.
sentences.zh: 实验结果表明，Trust3R 在风险-覆盖与稀疏化上持续改进，总体上提升了几何准确率，并在各基准上强化不确定性排序。

sentences.en: On ScanNet++, Trust3R achieves 25% lower AURC and 41% lower AUSE, providing a practical reliability signal for uncertainty-aware weighting in downstream geometry pipelines.
sentences.zh: 在 ScanNet++ 上，Trust3R 实现 AURC 降低 25%、AUSE 降低 41%，为下游几何流程中的不确定性感知加权提供了实用的可靠性信号。

sentences.en: Our project page and code are available at https://trust3r-z.github.io.
sentences.zh: 我们的项目页面与代码见 https://trust3r-z.github.io。

title_en: Trust Region Inverse Reinforcement Learning: Explicit Dual Ascent using Local Policy Updates
title_zh: 信任区域逆强化学习：用局部策略更新的显式对偶上升

sentences.en: Inverse reinforcement learning (IRL) is typically formulated as maximizing entropy subject to matching the distribution of expert trajectories.
sentences.zh: 逆强化学习（IRL）通常被形式化为在匹配专家轨迹分布约束下最大化熵。

sentences.en: Classical (dual-ascent)
sentences.zh: 经典（对偶上升）

sentences.en: IRL guarantees monotonic performance improvement but requires fully solving an RL problem each iteration to compute dual gradients.
sentences.zh: IRL 保证单调性能改进，但每轮迭代都需要完全求解一个 RL 问题来计算对偶梯度。

sentences.en: More recent adversarial methods avoid this cost at the expense of stability and monotonic dual improvement, by directly optimizing the primal problem and using a discriminator to provide rewards.
sentences.zh: 更近期的对抗方法通过直接优化原始问题并用判别器提供奖励来避免这一代价，但以稳定性与单调对偶改进为代价。

sentences.en: In this work, we bridge the gap between these approaches by enabling monotonic improvement of the reward function and policy without having to fully solve an RL problem at every iteration.
sentences.zh: 在这项工作中，我们弥合这些方法之间的差距，在不于每轮迭代完全求解一个 RL 问题的前提下，实现奖励函数与策略的单调改进。

sentences.en: Our key theoretical insight is that a trust-region-optimal policy for a reward function update can be globally optimal for a smaller update in the same direction.
sentences.zh: 我们的关键理论洞见是，针对奖励函数更新的信任区域最优策略，可以成为同方向更小更新的全局最优策略。

sentences.en: This smaller update allows us to explicitly optimize the dual objective while only relying on a local search around the current policy.
sentences.zh: 这一更小更新使我们能够在仅依赖当前策略周围局部搜索的情况下显式优化对偶目标。

sentences.en: In doing so, our approach avoids the training instabilities of adversarial methods, offers monotonic performance improvement, and learns a reward function in the traditional sense of IRL—one that can be globally optimized to match expert demonstrations.
sentences.zh: 这样一来，我们的方法避免了对抗方法的训练不稳定性，提供单调性能改进，并以 IRL 的传统意义学习一个奖励函数——一个可以被全局优化以匹配专家演示的函数。

sentences.en: Our proposed algorithm, *Trust Region Inverse Reinforcement Learning (TRIRL)*, outperforms state-of-the-art imitation learning methods across multiple challenging tasks by a factor of 2.4x in terms of aggregate inter-quartile mean, while recovering reward functions that generalize to system dynamics shifts.
sentences.zh: 我们提出的算法 *Trust Region Inverse Reinforcement Learning（TRIRL）* 在多个具有挑战性的任务上，以 2.4x 的聚合四分位均值因子击败最先进的模仿学习方法，同时恢复能泛化到系统动力学偏移的奖励函数。

authors.name: Davide Tateo
authors.institution: Lund University / Lund Institute of Technology

title_en: Trust Region Masking for Long-Horizon LLM Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: 面向长期 LLM 强化学习的信任区域掩码

sentences.en: Policy gradient methods for Large Language Models optimize a policy $\pi_\theta$ via a surrogate objective computed from samples of a rollout policy $\pi_{roll}$.
sentences.zh: 面向大语言模型的策略梯度方法，利用采样策略 $\pi_{roll}$ 生成的样本计算代理目标，从而优化策略 $\pi_\theta$。

sentences.en: However, modern LLM-RL pipelines suffer from unavoidable implementation divergences, such as backend discrepancies, Mixture-of-Experts routing discontinuities, and distributed training staleness.
sentences.zh: 然而，现代 LLM-RL 流程受难以避免的实现差异影响，例如后端不一致、专家混合路由不连续与分布式训练滞后。

sentences.en: These factors cause an off-policy mismatch ($\pi_{roll} \neq \pi_\theta$), leading to approximation errors between the surrogate and the true objective.
sentences.zh: 这些因素造成离策略不匹配（$\pi_{roll} \neq \pi_\theta$），导致代理与真实目标之间的近似误差。

sentences.en: We demonstrate that classical trust region bounds on this error scale as $O(T^2)$ with sequence length $T$, rendering them vacuous for long-horizon tasks.
sentences.zh: 我们证明该误差的经典信任区域界随序列长度 $T$ 按 $O(T^2)$ 缩放，使其对长期任务失效。

sentences.en: To address this, we derive two new bounds: a Pinsker-Marginal bound scaling as $O(T^{1.5})$ and a Mixed bound scaling as $O(T)$.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一点，我们推导两个新界：按 $O(T^{1.5})$ 缩放的 Pinsker-Marginal 界，以及按 $O(T)$ 缩放的 Mixed 界。

sentences.en: Crucially, both bounds depend on $D_{KL}^{max}$, the maximum token-level KL divergence across the sequence.
sentences.zh: 关键在于，两个界都依赖 $D_{KL}^{max}$，即序列中跨词元的最大 KL 散度。

sentences.en: As a sequence-level term, the divergence cannot be controlled by previous token-independent methods like PPO clipping.
sentences.zh: 作为序列级项，该散度无法被 PPO 裁剪等先前的词元无关方法控制。

sentences.en: We propose Trust Region Masking (TRM), which masks entire sequences that violate the trust region.
sentences.zh: 我们提出信任区域掩码（TRM），它掩码违反信任区域的整个序列。

sentences.en: TRM reduces the vacuity of traditional bounds, offering a principled framework to mitigate training collapse in long-horizon LLM-RL.
sentences.zh: TRM 降低了传统界的失效性，为缓解长期 LLM-RL 中的训练崩溃提供了一个有原则的框架。

authors.name: Baoxiang Wang
authors.institution: The Chinese University of Hong Kong

title_en: Trust-Region Diffusion Policies for Massively Parallel On-Policy RL
title_zh: 面向大规模并行在策略强化学习的信任区域扩散策略

sentences.en: Reinforcement learning with massively parallel simulations has become a standard framework for developing robust, deployable policies; however, most existing approaches still rely on simple Gaussian policy parameterizations.
sentences.zh: 带大规模并行模拟的强化学习已成为开发鲁棒、可部署策略的标准框架；然而，大多数现有方法仍依赖简单的高斯策略参数化。

sentences.en: Diffusion models provide a more expressive policy class and have shown strong performance on challenging control problems, yet most diffusion-based RL methods are designed for offline or off-policy training.
sentences.zh: 扩散模型提供了更有表达力的策略类别，并在具有挑战性的控制问题上表现强劲，但大多数基于扩散的 RL 方法是为离线或离策略训练设计的。

sentences.en: In this work, we ask whether diffusion policies can be trained effectively in the massively parallel, on-policy regime.
sentences.zh: 在这项工作中，我们追问扩散策略能否在大规模并行的在策略体制下被有效训练。

sentences.en: To this end, we introduce Trust-region Diffusion Policies (TruDi), which enables diffusion policies for on-policy RL with massively parallel simulations.
sentences.zh: 为此，我们引入信任区域扩散策略（TruDi），它为带大规模并行模拟的在策略 RL 启用扩散策略。

sentences.en: This setting is particularly challenging because the data distribution changes quickly across updates, making stable training with complex policies difficult.
sentences.zh: 这一设定特别具有挑战性，因为数据分布跨更新快速变化，使带复杂策略的稳定训练变得困难。

sentences.en: TruDi addresses this by integrating a trust-region optimization rule to enforce a KL-divergence constraint over the entire diffusion trajectory.
sentences.zh: TruDi 通过整合一个信任区域优化规则，对整条扩散轨迹强制 KL 散度约束来解决这一点。

sentences.en: Empirically, we evaluate TruDi on a diverse set of 4 massively parallel RL benchmarks comprising a total of 73 tasks.
sentences.zh: 在经验上，我们在包含 73 个任务的 4 个大规模并行 RL 基准的多样集合上评估 TruDi。

sentences.en: Across these tasks, TruDi consistently outperforms or is on-par with strong baselines on standard tasks and achieves clear gains on more challenging humanoid control tasks, establishing a strong new baseline for massively parallel on-policy RL.
sentences.zh: 跨这些任务，TruDi 在标准任务上一致优于或持平强基线，并在更具挑战性的类人控制任务上取得明显增益，为大规模并行在策略 RL 确立了强新基线。

authors.name: Claas Voelcker
authors.institution: University of Toronto, Queer in AI

authors.name: Axel Brunnbauer
authors.institution: TU Wien Vienna University of Technology

title_en: Trustworthy Federated Label Distribution Learning under Annotation Quality Disparity
title_zh: 标注质量差异下可信的联邦标签分布学习

sentences.en: Label Distribution Learning (LDL) models supervision as an instance-wise probability distribution, enabling fine-grained learning under inherent ambiguity, but its success relies on high-fidelity label distributions that are costly to obtain and thus often noisy.
sentences.zh: 标签分布学习（LDL）将监督建模为实例级概率分布，在固有模糊下实现细粒度学习，但其成功依赖高保真标签分布，而这类分布获取成本高昂，往往带有噪声。

sentences.en: Motivated by privacy-sensitive applications, we study Federated Label Distribution Learning (Fed-LDL), where data isolation further induces heterogeneous annotation quality across clients, making local updates unevenly reliable and breaking sample-size-based aggregation (e.g., FedAvg).
sentences.zh: 受隐私敏感应用启发，我们研究联邦标签分布学习（Fed-LDL），其中数据隔离还导致跨客户端异构的标注质量，使局部更新可靠性不均，并破坏基于样本量的聚合（例如 FedAvg）。

sentences.en: To address this trust dilemma, we propose FedQual, a quality-aware Fed-LDL framework with two coupled mechanisms: (i) quality-adaptive client training guided by a global semantic anchor that calibrates low-quality clients while preserving high-quality autonomy, and (ii) reliability-aware server aggregation that reweights client contributions by effective reliable information rather than raw sample size.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一信任困境，我们提出 FedQual，一个质量感知的 Fed-LDL 框架，带两种耦合机制：（i）由校准低质量客户端同时保持高质量自主性的全局语义锚引导的质量自适应客户端训练，以及（ii）按有效可靠信息而非原始样本量重新加权客户端贡献的可靠性感知服务器聚合。

sentences.en: To enable rigorous evaluation, we construct four new Fed-LDL benchmarks (FER-LDL, FI-LDL, PIPAL-LDL, and KADID-LDL) with controlled annotation quality disparity.
sentences.zh: 为支持严谨评估，我们构建四个带受控标注质量差异的 Fed-LDL 新基准（FER-LDL、FI-LDL、PIPAL-LDL 与 KADID-LDL）。

sentences.en: We further provide a theoretical guarantee showing that under heterogeneous supervision quality, client-specific calibration is strictly better than any uniform calibration.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步提供一个理论保证，表明在异构监督质量下，客户端特异的校准严格优于任何统一校准。

sentences.en: Experiments on the proposed benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of FedQual.
sentences.zh: 在所提基准上的实验证明了 FedQual 的有效性。

authors.name: Hongwei Zeng
authors.institution: University of the Chinese Academy of Sciences

title_en: TrustworthyQENN: A Quantum Evidential Neural Network Based on Complex-Valued Contrastive Learning for Uncertainty Pattern Classification
title_zh: TrustworthyQENN：基于复值对比学习、用于不确定性模式分类的量子证据神经网络

sentences.en: Out-of-distribution (OOD) detection requires accurately classifying in-distribution (ID) samples while effectively distinguishing anomalous OOD data.
sentences.zh: 分布外（OOD）检测需要在准确分类分布内（ID）样本的同时，有效区分异常的 OOD 数据。

sentences.en: However, existing methodologies predominantly rely on real-valued magnitude features, neglecting the semantic richness embedded in phase information, and often lack a systematic theoretical framework for quantitively modeling uncertainty.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有方法主要依赖实值幅度特征，忽视相位信息中蕴含的语义丰富性，且往往缺乏定量建模不确定性的系统化理论框架。

sentences.en: To address this dual limitation of incomplete feature representation and insufficient uncertainty modeling, the trustworthy quantum evidence neural network (TrustworthyQENN) is proposed, a novel quantum-inspired framework bridging complex-valued representation learning with generalized quantum evidence theory (GQET).
sentences.zh: 为应对特征表示不完整与不确定性建模不足的双重局限，我们提出可信量子证据神经网络（TrustworthyQENN），一个桥接复值表示学习与广义量子证据理论（GQET）的新颖类量子框架。

sentences.en: Specifically, supervised complex-valued contrastive learning (SCVCL) is proposed to synchronize amplitude distributions with phase correlations, thereby enforcing high intra-class compactness and inter-class separability for ID data.
sentences.zh: 具体地，提出监督复值对比学习（SCVCL）以同步幅度分布与相位相关性，从而对 ID 数据强制高的类内紧凑性与类间可分性。

sentences.en: A quantum evidence generation mechanism based on GQET is subsequently devised, where the OOD state is formally grounded as the quantum empty set within a Hilbert space.
sentences.zh: 随后设计一个基于 GQET 的量子证据生成机制，其中 OOD 状态被形式化地奠基于 Hilbert 空间中的量子空集。

sentences.en: Furthermore, the generalized quantum evidential combination rule (GQECR) is leveraged to fuse multi-view evidence, thereby achieving trustworthy inference.
sentences.zh: 此外，利用广义量子证据组合规则（GQECR）融合多视图证据，从而实现可信推断。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on the MSTAR, EuroSAT, and FUSAR-Ship benchmarks substantiate the superiority of TrustworthyQENN, which achieves a peak AUROC of 95.94\% on the MSTAR dataset while consistently outperforming state-of-the-art methods across all evaluated scenarios.
sentences.zh: 在 MSTAR、EuroSAT 与 FUSAR-Ship 基准上的大量实验证实了 TrustworthyQENN 的优越性，它在 MSTAR 数据集上取得 95.94\% 的峰值 AUROC，并在所有评估场景中一致优于最先进方法。

title_en: Truthfulness Does Not Scale Like Reasoning: Why Polling Fails as a Proxy Verifier
title_zh: 真实性不像推理那样扩展：为何投票作为代理验证器会失败

sentences.en: Pass@$k$ and other methods of scaling inference compute can improve language model performance in domains with external verifiers, including mathematics and code, where incorrect candidates can be filtered reliably.
sentences.zh: Pass@$\ldots$ 等扩展推理计算的方法可以改进带外部验证器领域中语言模型的性能，包括数学与代码，在这些领域不正确的候选可被可靠过滤。

sentences.en: This raises a natural question: can we similarly scale compute to elicit gains in truthfulness for domains without convenient verification?
sentences.zh: 这引发一个自然的问题：我们能否类似地扩展计算，以在缺乏便捷验证的领域中引出真实性的收益？

sentences.en: We show that across five benchmarks and models, surprisingly, it cannot.
sentences.zh: 我们在五个基准与多个模型上表明，令人惊讶的是，不能。

sentences.en: Even at $25\times$ the inference cost of naive sampling, polling-style aggregation yields no consistent accuracy gains over single-sample baselines and often amplifies correlated errors.
sentences.zh: 即使在朴素采样的 $25\times$ 推理成本下，投票式聚合也不会带来超过单样本基线的一致准确率增益，且往往放大相关误差。

sentences.en: We find that under uncertainty, models are better at predicting what other models will say within model ensembles than at identifying what is true, revealing a separation between social prediction and truth verification.
sentences.zh: 我们发现，在不确定性下，模型在预测模型集成内其他模型会说什么方面，比识别什么是真的做得更好，揭示了社会预测与真值验证之间的分离。

sentences.en: Across models and benchmarks, aggregation fails to provide a robust truth signal because language model errors are strongly correlated.
sentences.zh: 跨模型与基准，聚合无法提供鲁棒的真值信号，因为语言模型的误差强相关。

sentences.en: The source of correlation goes beyond any individual benchmark: we show that even when conditioned on out of distribution random strings and asked to produce pseudo-random outputs, different models produce correlated outputs.
sentences.zh: 相关性的来源超越任何一个单独基准：我们表明，即使以分布外随机字符串为条件并请求产生伪随机输出，不同模型也会产生相关输出。

sentences.en: Confidence-based weighting provides no benefit because self-reported confidence fails to reliably distinguish correct from incorrect answers.
sentences.zh: 基于置信度的加权没有益处，因为自我报告的置信度无法可靠区分正确与错误答案。

sentences.en: These results delineate a boundary for inference-time scaling: in verified domains, additional samples provide more candidates for a verifier to filter; in unverified domains, additional samples merely reinforce correlated errors.
sentences.zh: 这些结果界定了推理时扩展的一个边界：在已验证领域中，额外样本为验证器提供更多候选以过滤；在未验证领域中，额外样本只是强化相关误差。

title_en: TruthRL: Incentivizing Truthful LLMs via Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: TruthRL：通过强化学习激励诚实的 LLM

sentences.en: While large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong performance on factoid question answering, they are still prone to hallucination and untruthful responses, particularly when tasks demand information outside their parametric knowledge.
sentences.zh: 虽然大语言模型（LLM）在事实性问题回答上展现了强劲性能，但它们仍容易产生幻觉与不诚实的回答，尤其当任务要求超出其参数化知识之外的信息时。

sentences.en: Indeed, truthfulness requires more than accuracy---models must also recognize uncertainty and abstain when unsure to avoid hallucinations.
sentences.zh: 事实上，诚实需要的不止准确率——模型还必须识别不确定性，并在不确定时弃权以避免幻觉。

sentences.en: This presents a fundamental challenge for existing methods: approaches that optimize for accuracy often amplify hallucinations, while those that encourage abstention can become overly conservative, sacrificing correct answers.
sentences.zh: 这对现有方法构成根本性挑战：优化准确率的方法往往放大幻觉，而鼓励弃权的方法可能变得过度保守，牺牲正确答案。

sentences.en: Both extremes ultimately compromise truthfulness.
sentences.zh: 这两个极端最终都损害诚实性。

sentences.en: In this work, we present TruthRL, a general reinforcement learning (RL) framework that directly optimizes the truthfulness of LLMs.
sentences.zh: 在这项工作中，我们提出 TruthRL，一个直接优化 LLM 诚实性的通用强化学习（RL）框架。

sentences.en: Specifically, we implement TruthRL using GRPO with a simple yet effective ternary reward that distinguishes correct answers, hallucinations, and abstentions.
sentences.zh: 具体地，我们用带简单而有效的三元奖励的 GRPO 实现 TruthRL，该奖励区分正确答案、幻觉与弃权。

sentences.en: It incentivizes models to reduce hallucinations not only by providing correct responses, but also by enabling abstention when uncertain, thereby improving truthfulness.
sentences.zh: 它激励模型不仅通过提供正确回答，还通过在不确定时允许弃权来减少幻觉，从而提升诚实性。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments across four knowledge-intensive benchmarks show that TruthRL significantly reduces hallucinations (e.g., 43.5\% $\rightarrow$ 19.4\%) and improves truthfulness (e.g., 5.3\% $\rightarrow$ 37.2\%), with consistent gains across various backbone models.
sentences.zh: 跨四个知识密集型基准的大量实验表明，TruthRL 显著减少幻觉（例如 43.5\% $\rightarrow$ 19.4\%）并提升诚实性（例如 5.3\% $\rightarrow$ 37.2\%），在多种骨干模型上取得一致增益。

sentences.en: Analysis shows that the improvement of TruthRL arises from enhanced capability of LLMs to recognize their knowledge boundary, hence avoiding being overly conservative as the baselines are.
sentences.zh: 分析表明，TruthRL 的改进源于 LLM 识别自身知识边界的能力增强，从而避免像基线那样过度保守。

title_en: TSFAdv: Frequency-Guided Black-Box Adversarial Attacks on Time Series Forecasting
title_zh: TSFAdv：面向时间序列预测的频率引导黑盒对抗攻击

sentences.en: While deep neural network-based long-term time series forecasting (LTSF) has become indispensable for critical infrastructures such as smart grids and IoT platforms, the deployment of these models as black-box APIs introduces severe security vulnerabilities that remain largely underexplored.
sentences.zh: 虽然基于深度神经网络的长时时间序列预测（LTSF）对智能电网与物联网平台等关键基础设施已不可或缺，但将这些模型部署为黑盒 API 带来了严重的安全漏洞，而这些漏洞在很大程度上仍未被充分探索。

sentences.en: In this paper, we propose TSFAdv, a query-efficient adversarial framework for LTSF models.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们提出 TSFAdv，一个面向 LTSF 模型的查询高效对抗框架。

sentences.en: The framework systematically analyzes model sensitivity to spectral perturbations in both magnitude and phase of the frequency domain.
sentences.zh: 该框架系统地分析模型对频域中幅度与相位两方面频谱扰动的敏感性。

sentences.en: By embedding frequency-domain priors into Natural Evolution Strategies, we achieve sensitivity-guided gradient estimation that improves perturbation efficacy without violating practical query constraints.
sentences.zh: 通过将频率域先验嵌入自然进化策略，我们实现敏感性引导的梯度估计，在不违反实际查询约束的情况下提升扰动效力。

sentences.en: To overcome ambiguities inherent to point-wise regression metrics, we adopt a trajectory-level evaluation protocol based on Dynamic Time Warping (DTW) and Slope Misalignment Error (SME), enabling the capture of complex geometric and directional deviations.
sentences.zh: 为克服逐点回归指标固有的模糊性，我们采用基于动态时间规整（DTW）与斜率失准误差（SME）的轨迹级评估协议，从而能够捕捉复杂的几何与方向偏差。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments across seven state-of-the-art architectures demonstrate that TSFAdv achieves substantial performance gains, with median DTW improvements of 38.78\% and median SME improvements of 26.47\% under 200-query budget.
sentences.zh: 跨七种最先进架构的大量实验表明，TSFAdv 实现大幅性能增益，在 200-查询预算下 DTW 中位数改进 38.78\%、SME 中位数改进 26.47\%。

sentences.en: These findings reveal that existing defense mechanisms are ineffective against frequency-domain manipulation, underscoring an urgent necessity for robust LTSF models.
sentences.zh: 这些发现揭示，现有防御机制对频域操纵无效，凸显了对鲁棒 LTSF 模型的迫切需求。

title_en: TsLLM: Augmenting LLMs for General Time Series Understanding and Prediction
title_zh: TsLLM：增强 LLM 实现通用时间序列理解与预测

sentences.en: Time series data is fundamental to decision-making across many domains including healthcare, finance, power systems, and logistics.
sentences.zh: 时间序列数据对医疗、金融、电力系统与物流等多个领域的决策至关重要。

sentences.en: However, analyzing this data correctly often requires incorporating unstructured contextual information, answering domain-specific questions, and generating natural language explanations – capabilities that traditional time series models lack.
sentences.zh: 然而，正确分析这些数据往往需要纳入非结构化的上下文信息、回答领域特定问题并生成自然语言解释––这些是传统时间序列模型所缺乏的能力。

sentences.en: While Large Language Models (LLMs) excel at contextual reasoning and knowledge integration, they struggle with numerical time series due to inefficient text-based representations and limited exposure to numerical data during pretraining.
sentences.zh: 虽然大语言模型（LLM）擅长上下文推理与知识整合，它们却因低效的基于文本的表示以及预训练期间数值数据接触有限，而在数值时间序列上挣扎。

sentences.en: We address this gap by augmenting an LLM with specialized time series perception through a patch-based encoder-decoder architecture.
sentences.zh: 我们通过基于分块的编码器-解码器架构为 LLM 增强专门的时间序列感知，来弥合这一差距。

sentences.en: We train this time series-augmented LLM (TsLLM) on a large corpus of over 25 billion tokens of interleaved time series and text spanning diverse tasks: forecasting with contextual information, question-answering, anomaly detection, classification, report generation, and more, all unified as autoregressive next token prediction.
sentences.zh: 我们在超过 250 亿词元的交错时间序列与文本大规模语料上训练这一时间序列增强 LLM（TsLLM），覆盖多样任务：带上下文信息的预测、问题回答、异常检测、分类、报告生成等，全部统一为自回归下一词元预测。

sentences.en: This training enables TsLLM to leverage both its natural language skills and newly acquired understanding of numerical time series signals.
sentences.zh: 这一训练使 TsLLM 能够同时利用其自然语言技能与新习得的数值时间序列信号理解力。

sentences.en: While not designed to surpass specialized models on traditional benchmarks, TsLLM demonstrates strong performance on tasks requiring the integration of time series analysis with natural language – capabilities that conventional approaches cannot provide.
sentences.zh: 虽然并不旨在超越专业模型在传统基准上的表现，TsLLM 在需要将时间序列分析与自然语言整合的任务上展现出强劲性能––这些是传统方法无法提供的能力。

sentences.en: It also exhibits strong zero-shot and few-shot performance, showing it can adapt to new data without additional training.
sentences.zh: 它还展现出强零样本与少样本性能，表明无需额外训练即可适应新数据。

title_en: TSMGen: Target-Specific Molecule Generation via Higher-Order Structural Dependencies and Context-Aware Bidirectional Fusion
title_zh: TSMGen：经高阶结构依赖与上下文感知双向融合实现靶点特定分子生成

sentences.en: Efficiently designing high-quality molecules targeting disease-relevant targets is a critical challenge.
sentences.zh: 高效设计针对疾病相关靶点的高质量分子是一项关键挑战。

sentences.en: Most existing methods can capture pairwise amino acid relations, neglecting the higher-order relations among multiple amino acids.
sentences.zh: 大多数现有方法只能捕捉成对氨基酸关系，忽视了多个氨基酸之间的高阶关系。

sentences.en: This paper proposes a target-specific molecule generation framework, namely TSMGen, to comprehensively capture the local and global structural information of the protein pocket by modeling higher-order spatial dependencies both at the atomic and the amino acid levels.
sentences.zh: 本文提出一个靶点特定分子生成框架，即 TSMGen，通过在原子级与氨基酸级两个层面建模高阶空间依赖，全面捕捉蛋白质口袋的局部与整体结构信息。

sentences.en: Furthermore, we design a context-aware bidirectional fusion module to learn the more detailed structural information about the protein pocket.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们设计了一个上下文感知双向融合模块，以学习关于蛋白质口袋更详细的结构信息。

sentences.en: This module simultaneously attends to features from both the protein pocket and the molecule, fully leveraging the structural information from both to optimize the generation process of targeted molecules, thereby enhancing the quality of generated molecules.
sentences.zh: 该模块同时关注来自蛋白质口袋与分子两者的特征，充分利用两者的结构信息来优化靶向分子的生成过程，从而提升生成分子的质量。

sentences.en: Experiments show that TSMGen outperforms state-of-the-art methods in terms of Vina Score, High Affinity, QED, SA and Diversity, and a case study on $\beta$-secretase enzyme further confirms its ability to generate molecules with stronger binding affinity.
sentences.zh: 实验表明，TSMGen 在 Vina Score、High Affinity、QED、SA 与 Diversity 上优于最先进方法，且对 $\beta$-分泌酶的案例研究进一步证实其生成结合亲和力更强分子的能力。

title_en: TSP with Predictions: Heatmap to Tour with Provable Guarantees
title_zh: 带预测的 TSP：可证明保证下从热图到回路

sentences.en: The Traveling Salesperson Problem (TSP) has long served as a benchmark for evaluating the strength of optimization techniques in the classical theory of algorithms.
sentences.zh: 旅行商问题（TSP）长期以来一直是评估经典算法理论中优化技术强度的基准。

sentences.en: In recent efforts to apply ML to algorithmic problems, TSP has also become a natural testbed for the development of ML-based techniques.
sentences.zh: 在近来将 ML 应用于算法问题的努力中，TSP 也成为基于 ML 技术开发的自然测试床。

sentences.en: A common approach is to train a neural network to output a heatmap estimating the likelihood of each edge to be part of the optimal tour; however, converting such a heatmap into an actual tour remains a non-trivial and often computationally intensive step.
sentences.zh: 一种常见方法是训练神经网络输出一个热图，估计每条边属于最优回路一部分的可能性；然而，将这样的热图转换为实际回路仍是一个非平凡且往往计算密集的步骤。

sentences.en: In this work, we propose algorithms for transforming heatmaps into tours with theoretical guarantees linking the achieved approximation ratio to the quality of the provided heatmap.
sentences.zh: 在这项工作中，我们提出将热图变换为回路的算法，并带将所得近似比与所提供热图质量联系起来的理论保证。

sentences.en: In the spirit of *algorithms with predictions*, our results can be described as $(1+2\eta/OPT)$-approximation algorithms, where $\eta$ denotes the L1 distance between the prediction (heatmap) and an optimal solution (tour).
sentences.zh: 本着*带预测的算法*的精神，我们的结果可描述为 $(1+2\eta/OPT)$-近似算法，其中 $\eta$ 表示预测（热图）与最优解（回路）之间的 L1 距离。

sentences.en: Since the previous works lack such explicit guarantees, we compare our approach against them experimentally.
sentences.zh: 由于先前工作缺乏这种显式保证，我们在实验上将我们的方法与它们比较。

title_en: TSRBench: A Comprehensive Multi-task Multi-modal Time Series Reasoning Benchmark for Generalist Models
title_zh: TSRBench：面向通才模型的全面多任务多模态时间序列推理基准

sentences.en: Time series are ubiquitous in real-world scenarios and crucial for applications ranging from energy management to traffic control.
sentences.zh: 时间序列在真实世界场景中无处不在，对从能源管理到交通控制的各类应用至关重要。

sentences.en: Consequently, the ability to reason over time series is a fundamental skill for generalist models to solve complex problems.
sentences.zh: 因此，对时间序列进行推理的能力是通才模型解决复杂问题的一项基本技能。

sentences.en: However, current benchmarks for generalist models largely overlook this dimension.
sentences.zh: 然而，当前面向通才模型的基准在很大程度上忽视了这一维度。

sentences.en: To bridge this gap, we introduce TSRBench, a comprehensive multi-modal benchmark designed to stress-test the full spectrum of time series reasoning capabilities.
sentences.zh: 为弥合这一差距，我们引入 TSRBench，一个为压力测试时间序列推理能力全谱系而设计的综合多模态基准。

sentences.en: TSRBench features: i) a diverse set of 4125 problems from 14 domains, and is categorized into 4 major dimensions: Perception, Reasoning, Prediction, and Decision-Making. ii) 15 tasks from the 4 dimensions evaluating essential reasoning capabilities (e.g., numerical reasoning).
sentences.zh: TSRBench 的特点：i）一个来自 14 个领域的 4125 个问题的多样集合，并被归类为 4 个主要维度：感知、推理、预测与决策制定；ii）来自这 4 个维度、评估基本推理能力（例如数值推理）的 15 个任务。

sentences.en: Through extensive experiments, we evaluate over 30 leading proprietary and open-source LLMs, VLMs, and TSLLMs within TSRBench.
sentences.zh: 通过大量实验，我们在 TSRBench 内评估了超过 30 个领先的专有与开源 LLM、VLM 与 TSLLM。

sentences.en: Our findings reveal that: i) scaling laws hold for perception and reasoning but break down for prediction; ii) strong reasoning does not guarantee accurate context-aware forecasting, indicating a decoupling between semantic understanding and numerical prediction; and iii) despite the complementary nature of textual and visual forms of time series as inputs, current multimodal models fail to effectively fuse them for reciprocal performance gains.
sentences.zh: 我们的发现揭示：i）缩放定律对感知与推理成立，但对预测失效；ii）强推理并不保证准确的上下文感知预测，表明语义理解与数值预测之间的解耦；iii）尽管时间序列的文本与视觉形式作为输入具有互补性，当前多模态模型无法有效融合它们以获得互利的性能增益。

sentences.en: TSRBench provides a standardized evaluation platform that not only highlights existing challenges but also offers valuable insights to advance generalist models.
sentences.zh: TSRBench 提供了一个标准化评估平台，不仅凸显现有挑战，还为推进通才模型提供宝贵见解。

sentences.en: Our code and dataset are available at https://tsrbench.github.io/.
sentences.zh: 我们的代码与数据集见 https://tsrbench.github.io/。

title_en: TT-Sparse: Learning Sparse Rule Models with Differentiable Truth Tables
title_zh: TT-Sparse：用可微真值表学习稀疏规则模型

sentences.en: Interpretable machine learning is essential in high-stakes domains where decision-making requires accountability, transparency, and trust.
sentences.zh: 可解释机器学习在需要问责、透明与信任的高风险领域中至关重要。

sentences.en: While rule-based models offer global and exact interpretability, learning rule sets that simultaneously achieve high predictive performance and low, human-understandable complexity remains challenging.
sentences.zh: 虽然基于规则的模型提供全局且精确的可解释性，但学习同时达到高预测性能与低、人类可理解复杂度的规则集仍具挑战性。

sentences.en: To address this, we introduce TT-Sparse, a flexible neural building block that leverages differentiable truth tables as nodes to learn sparse, effective connections.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一点，我们引入 TT-Sparse，一个灵活的神经构件，它利用作为节点的可微真值表，学习稀疏、有效的连接。

sentences.en: A key contribution of our approach is a new soft TopK operator with straight-through estimation for learning discrete, cardinality-constrained feature selection in an end-to-end differentiable manner.
sentences.zh: 我们方法的一个关键贡献是一个带直通估计的新型 soft TopK 算子，用于以端到端可微的方式学习离散、基数约束的特征选择。

sentences.en: Crucially, the forward pass remains sparse, enabling each node (and the entire model) to be transformed exactly into compact, globally interpretable DNF/CNF Boolean formulas via Quine--McCluskey minimization.
sentences.zh: 关键在于，前向传播保持稀疏，使每个节点（以及整个模型）都能经 Quine--McCluskey 最小化精确转换为紧凑、全局可解释的 DNF/CNF 布尔公式。

sentences.en: Extensive empirical results across 28 datasets spanning binary, multiclass, and regression tasks show that the learned sparse rules exhibit superior predictive performance with lower complexity compared to existing state-of-the-art methods.
sentences.zh: 跨涵盖二分类、多分类与回归任务的 28 个数据集的大量实证结果表明，与现有最先进方法相比，习得的稀疏规则以更低复杂度展现出优越的预测性能。

title_en: Tucker Attention: A generalization of approximate attention mechanisms
title_zh: Tucker 注意力：近似注意力机制的推广

sentences.en: The pursuit of reducing the memory footprint of the self-attention mechanism in multi-headed self attention (MHA) spawned a rich portfolio of methods, e.g., group-query attention (GQA) and multi-head latent attention (MLA).
sentences.zh: 减少多头自注意力（MHA）机制内存占用的追求催生了丰富的方法组合，例如组查询注意力（GQA）与多头潜在注意力（MLA）。

sentences.en: The methods leverage specialized low-rank factorizations across embedding dimensions or attention heads.
sentences.zh: 这些方法利用跨嵌入维度或注意力头的专门低秩分解。

sentences.en: From the point of view of classical low-rank approximation, these methods are unconventional and raise questions of which objects they really approximate and how to interpret the low-rank behavior of the resulting representations.
sentences.zh: 从经典低秩近似的角度看，这些方法非同寻常，并引发它们究竟近似哪些对象以及如何解释所得表示的低秩行为的问题。

sentences.en: To answer these questions, this work proposes a generalized view on the weight objects in the self-attention layer and a factorization strategy, which allows us to construct a parameter efficient scheme, called Tucker Attention.
sentences.zh: 为回答这些问题，本文提出一个关于自注意力层中权重对象的广义视角与一种分解策略，使我们能够构造一个参数高效的方案，称为 Tucker 注意力。

sentences.en: Tucker Attention requires an order of magnitude fewer parameters for comparable validation metrics, compared to GQA and MLA, as evaluated in LLM and ViT test cases.
sentences.zh: 在 LLM 与 ViT 测试用例中的评估表明，与 GQA 和 MLA 相比，Tucker 注意力在相当的验证指标下需要少一个数量级的参数。

sentences.en: Additionally, Tucker Attention~encompasses GQA, MLA, MHA as special cases and is fully compatible with flash-attention and rotary position embeddings (RoPE).
sentences.zh: 此外，Tucker 注意力~涵盖 GQA、MLA、MHA 作为特例，并与 flash-attention 及旋转位置嵌入（RoPE）完全兼容。

sentences.en: This generalization strategy yields insights of the actual ranks achieved by MHA, GQA, and MLA, and further enables simplifications for MLA.
sentences.zh: 这一推广策略为 MHA、GQA 与 MLA 实际达到的秩提供洞见，并进一步为 MLA 启用了简化。

topic: General Machine Learning->Transfer, Multitask and Meta-learning
title_en: TuneAhead: Predicting Fine-tuning Performance Before Training Begins
title_zh: TuneAhead：在训练开始前预测微调性能

sentences.en: Fine-tuning large language models (LLMs) is compute-intensive and error-prone: model performance depends sensitively on data quality and hyperparameter choices, and naïve runs can even degrade model performance.
sentences.zh: 微调大语言模型（LLM）计算密集且易出错：模型性能敏感地依赖数据质量与超参数选择，而朴素的运行甚至可能降低模型性能。

sentences.en: This raises a practical question:can we predict fine-tuning performance before committing to a full training run?
sentences.zh: 这引发一个实际问题：在投入完整训练运行之前，能否预测微调性能？

sentences.en: We present TUNEAHEAD, a lightweight framework for pre-hoc prediction of fine-tuning performance.
sentences.zh: 我们提出 TUNEAHEAD，一个用于微调性能事前预测的轻量级框架。

sentences.en: TUNEAHEAD encodes each candidate run as a meta-feature vector that combines static dataset descriptors with dynamic probe features from a short standardized probe.
sentences.zh: TUNEAHEAD 将每个候选运行编码为一个元特征向量，它将静态数据集描述符与来自短标准探针的动态探针特征相结合。

sentences.en: A predictor maps these features to performance estimates, while SHAP-based attributions provide interpretable diagnostics that reveal which specific features drive the prediction.
sentences.zh: 一个预测器将这些特征映射为性能估计，而基于 SHAP 的归因提供可解释的诊断，揭示哪些具体特征驱动预测。

sentences.en: Across 1,300+ fine-tuning runs on Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, TUNEAHEAD consistently outperforms strong baselines such as Early-Stop Extrapolation and ProxyLM.
sentences.zh: 跨 1,300+ 次 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 微调运行，TUNEAHEAD 一致优于 Early-Stop Extrapolation 与 ProxyLM 等强基线。

sentences.en: On a held-out test set of 370 runs, TUNEAHEAD achieves an RMSE of 1.47 percentage points and places 95.1% of predictions within ±3 percentage points of the true score.
sentences.zh: 在 370 次运行的留出测试集上，TUNEAHEAD 达到 1.47 个百分点的RMSE，并将 95.1% 的预测置于真实分数的 ±3 个百分点以内。

sentences.en: These accurate continuous predictions support practical go/no-go screening policies that can reduce unnecessary full fine-tuning while retaining most promising runs.
sentences.zh: 这些准确的连续预测支持实用的 go/no-go 筛选策略，既减少不必要的完整微调，又保留最有前景的运行。

title_en: Tuning the Implicit Regularizer of Masked Diffusion Language Models: Enhancing Generalization via Insights from $k$-Parity
title_zh: 调优掩码扩散语言模型的隐式正则化器：来自 $\boldsymbol{k}$-Parity 的洞见增强泛化

sentences.en: Masked Diffusion Language Models have recently emerged as a powerful generative paradigm, yet their generalization properties remain understudied compared to their auto-regressive counterparts.
sentences.zh: 掩码扩散语言模型近年作为强大的生成范式而涌现，但与自回归对应物相比，其泛化性质仍未得到充分研究。

sentences.en: In this work, we investigate these properties within the setting of the $k$-parity problem (computing the XOR sum of $k$ relevant bits), where neural networks typically exhibit grokking—a prolonged plateau of chance-level performance followed by sudden generalization.
sentences.zh: 在这项工作中，我们在 $k$-parity 问题（计算 $k$ 个相关比特的 XOR 和）的设定下研究这些性质，其中神经网络通常表现出 grokking——一个持久的随机水平平台期之后突然泛化。

sentences.en: We theoretically decompose the Masked Diffusion (MD) objective into a Signal regime which drives feature learning, and a Noise regime which serves as an implicit regularizer.
sentences.zh: 我们在理论上将掩码扩散（MD）目标分解为驱动特征学习的 Signal 区域，以及作为隐式正则化器的 Noise 区域。

sentences.en: By training nanoGPT using MD objective on the $k$-parity problem, we demonstrate that MD objective fundamentally alters the learning landscape, enabling rapid and simultaneous generalization without experiencing grokking.
sentences.zh: 通过在 $k$-parity 问题上用 MD 目标训练 nanoGPT，我们证明 MD 目标从根本上改变了学习景观，无需经历 grokking 即可实现快速且同时的泛化。

sentences.en: Furthermore, we leverage our theoretical insights to optimize the distribution of the mask probability in the MD objective.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们利用理论洞见优化 MD 目标中掩码概率的分布。

sentences.en: Our method significantly improves perplexity for 50M-parameter models and achieves superior results across both pre-training from scratch and supervised fine-tuning.
sentences.zh: 我们的方法显著改进 50M 参数模型的困惑度，并在从零预训练与监督微调两方面都取得优越结果。

sentences.en: Specifically, we observe performance gains peaking at $8.8$% and $5.8$%, respectively, on 8B-parameter models, confirming the scalability and effectiveness of our framework in large-scale masked diffusion language model regimes.
sentences.zh: 具体地，我们观察到在 8B 参数模型上性能增益分别达 $8.8$% 与 $5.8$%，证实我们框架在大规模掩码扩散语言模型体制中的可扩展性与有效性。

topic: General Machine Learning->Unsupervised and Semi-supervised Learning
title_en: Tuning-Free One-Class Discriminant Learning for Tabular Anomaly Detection
title_zh: 面向表格异常检测的免调参一类判别学习

sentences.en: Anomaly detection (AD) on real-world tabular data is challenged by diverse anomaly types, scarce labels, and high sensitivity to data-specific hyperparameter tuning.
sentences.zh: 真实世界表格数据上的异常检测（AD）受到多样异常类型、稀缺标签与对数据特定超参数调参的高度敏感性等挑战。

sentences.en: A central difficulty is that different anomaly types favor opposing representations: *compactness* - tightening the normal class to expose pointwise deviations - and *structure preservation* - retaining cluster and cross-feature relationships.
sentences.zh: 一个核心困难是不同异常类型偏爱相反的表示：*紧凑性*——收紧正常类以暴露逐点偏差——与*结构保持*——保留簇内跨特征关系。

sentences.en: Existing one-class detectors capture only one of these or balance them via hyperparameters, which is problematic without validation labels.
sentences.zh: 现有单类检测器只捕捉其中之一，或通过超参数平衡它们，而在没有验证标签时这会产生问题。

sentences.en: We propose **Discriminant Vector Machine for Anomaly Detection (DVM-AD)**, a closed-form one-class method derived from discriminant analysis that captures both behaviors under a single fixed configuration.
sentences.zh: 我们提出 **Discriminant Vector Machine for Anomaly Detection（DVM-AD）**，一个源自判别分析、在单一固定配置下捕捉两种行为的闭式单类方法。

sentences.en: From a deterministic reference point built from the training data, DVM-AD derives a bounded ratio whose two ends correspond to compressive and structure-preserving directions.
sentences.zh: 从一个由训练数据构建的确定性参考点出发，DVM-AD 导出一个有界比值，其两端对应压缩方向与结构保持方向。

sentences.en: This bound enables selecting directions from both ends simultaneously without dataset-specific tuning.
sentences.zh: 这一界使其能够同时在两端选择方向，而无需数据集特异的调参。

sentences.en: In addition, a Moore-Penrose pseudo-inverse keeps the method well-posed under high-dimensional or rank-deficient settings, and test samples are scored by nearest-neighbor distance in the discriminant space, normalized for thresholding-ready use.
sentences.zh: 此外，Moore-Penrose 伪逆使该方法在高维或秩亏设定下保持适定，测试样本按判别空间中的最近邻距离评分，并归一化以供直接阈值化使用。

sentences.en: Across 47 ADBench tabular datasets and 10 NLP/CV embedding benchmarks against 28 baselines, DVM-AD achieves the best average AUROC (89.65\%, average rank 2.98) on tabular datasets and remains top-ranked across four anomaly types and on embedding tasks (average rank 1.60, AUROC 72.68\%).
sentences.zh: 在 47 个 ADBench 表格数据集与 10 个 NLP/CV 嵌入基准上相对 28 个基线，DVM-AD 在表格数据集上取得最佳平均 AUROC（89.65\%，平均排名 2.98），并在四种异常类型及嵌入任务上保持领先（平均排名 1.60，AUROC 72.68\%）。

title_en: TUR-DPO: Topology- and Uncertainty-Aware Direct Preference Optimization
title_zh: TUR-DPO：拓扑与不确定性感知的直接偏好优化

sentences.en: Aligning large language models (LLMs) with human preferences is commonly done via reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) with Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) or, more simply, via Direct Preference Optimization (DPO).
sentences.zh: 将大语言模型（LLM）与人类偏好对齐通常通过带近端策略优化（PPO）的基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）完成，或更简单地通过直接偏好优化（DPO）完成。

sentences.en: While DPO is stable and RL-free, it treats preferences as flat winner vs. loser signals and is sensitive to noisy or brittle preferences arising from fragile chains of thought.
sentences.zh: 虽然 DPO 稳定且无需 RL，但它将偏好视为扁平的胜者对败者信号，并对源自脆弱思维链的噪声或脆弱偏好敏感。

sentences.en: We propose TUR-DPO, a topology- and uncertainty-aware variant of DPO that rewards how answers are derived, not only what they say, by eliciting lightweight reasoning topologies and combining semantic faithfulness, utility, and topology quality into a calibrated uncertainty signal.
sentences.zh: 我们提出 TUR-DPO，一个拓扑与不确定性感知的 DPO 变体，它通过引出轻量级推理拓扑并将语义忠实度、效用与拓扑质量组合成校准的不确定性信号，奖励答案*如何*得出而非仅仅*说了什么*。

sentences.en: A small learnable reward is factorized over these signals and incorporated into an uncertainty-weighted DPO objective that remains RL-free and relies only on a fixed or moving reference policy.
sentences.zh: 一个小型可学奖励在这些信号上因式分解，并被纳入不确定性加权的 DPO 目标，后者仍然无需 RL，仅依赖一个固定或移动的参考策略。

sentences.en: Empirically, across open 7–8B models and benchmarks spanning mathematical reasoning, factual question answering, summarization, and helpful/harmless dialogue, TUR-DPO improves judge win-rates, faithfulness, and calibration relative to DPO while preserving training simplicity and avoiding online rollouts.
sentences.zh: 在经验上，跨开源 7–8B 模型及涵盖数学推理、事实问题回答、摘要与有帮助/无害对话的基准，TUR-DPO 相对 DPO 改进了评委胜率、忠实度与校准，同时保持训练简易性并避免在线回滚。

sentences.en: We further observe consistent gains in multimodal and long-context settings, and show that TUR-DPO matches or exceeds PPO on reasoning-centric tasks while maintaining operational simplicity.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步在多样态与长上下文设定中观察到一致增益，并表明 TUR-DPO 在推理中心任务上匹配或超越 PPO，同时维持操作简易性。

title_en: Turbo Connection: Reasoning as Information Flow from Higher to Lower Layers
title_zh: Turbo 连接：作为从高层到低层信息流的推理

sentences.en: Complex problems, whether in math, logic, or planning, are solved by humans through a sequence of steps where the result of one step informs the next.
sentences.zh: 人类解决复杂问题（无论是数学、逻辑还是规划）都通过一系列步骤进行，其中一步的结果为下一步提供信息。

sentences.en: In this work, we adopt the perspective that the reasoning power of Transformers is fundamentally limited by a fixed maximum number of steps along any latent path of computation.
sentences.zh: 在这项工作中，我们采纳这样的视角：Transformer 的推理能力从根本上受限于沿任何潜在计算路径的固定最大步数。

sentences.en: To address this, we introduce Turbo Connection (TurboConn), a novel architecture that overcomes the fixed-depth constraint by routing multiple residual connections from the higher-layer hidden states of each token $t$ to the lower layers of token $t+1$.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一点，我们引入 Turbo 连接（TurboConn），一个新颖架构，它通过在词元 $t$ 的高层隐藏状态与词元 $t+1$ 的低层之间路由多条残差连接，克服固定深度约束。

sentences.en: Fine-tuning pre-trained LLMs with our method not only yields accuracy gains of 0.9\% to over 10\% on benchmarks like GSM8K, Parity, and multi-step arithmetic, but also demonstrates that the density of these backward connections is critical; our dense interaction significantly outperforms "sparse" alternatives that only pass a single hidden state or vector.
sentences.zh: 用我们的方法微调预训练 LLM 不仅在 GSM8K、Parity 与多步算术等基准上带来 0.9\% 到超过 10\% 的准确率增益，还表明这些反向连接的密度至关重要；我们的密集交互显著优于仅传递一个隐藏状态或向量的“稀疏”替代方案。

sentences.en: Notably, TurboConn can be integrated into pre-trained LLMs to overcome task-specific plateaus: while a fine-tuned Qwen-3-1.7B achieves only 53.78\% on Parity, adding our architectural modification enables the model to reach 100\% accuracy, all without the necessity to retrain the full model from scratch or sophisticated curriculum learning.
sentences.zh: 值得注意的是，TurboConn 可以集成进预训练 LLM 以克服任务特定的平台期：虽然微调后的 Qwen-3-1.7B 在 Parity 上仅达 53.78\%，但加入我们的架构修改使模型达到 100\% 准确率，且完全无需从头重训整个模型或复杂的课程学习。

sentences.en: Our results provide strong empirical evidence that the depth of the computational path is a key factor in reasoning ability, also offering a new mechanism to enhance LLMs without significantly affecting generation latency.
sentences.zh: 我们的结果为计算路径的深度是推理能力关键因素提供了强经验证据，也提供了一种在基本不影响生成延迟的情况下增强 LLM 的新机制。

authors.name: Mohan Tang
authors.institution: UCLA Computer Science Department, University of California, Los Angeles

title_en: Turbo4DGen: Ultra-Fast Acceleration for 4D Generation
title_zh: Turbo4DGen：4D 生成的超快加速

sentences.en: 4D generation, or dynamic 3D content generation, integrates spatial, temporal, and view dimensions to model realistic dynamic scenes, playing a foundational role in advancing world models and physical AI.
sentences.zh: 4D 生成，即动态 3D 内容生成，整合空间、时间与视图维度以建模真实动态场景，在推进世界模型与物理 AI 中发挥基础作用。

sentences.en: However, maintaining long-chain consistency across both frames and viewpoints through the unique spatio-camera-motion (SCM) attention mechanism introduces substantial computational and memory overhead, often leading to out-of-memory (OOM) failures and prohibitive generation times.
sentences.zh: 然而，通过独特的空间-相机-运动（SCM）注意力机制在帧与视点两方面维持长链一致性，带来了大量计算与内存开销，往往导致内存溢出（OOM）失效与令人望而却步的生成时间。

sentences.en: To address these challenges, we propose Turbo4DGen, an ultra-fast acceleration framework for diffusion-based multi-view 4D content generation.
sentences.zh: 为应对这些挑战，我们提出 Turbo4DGen，一个用于基于扩散的多视图 4D 内容生成的超快加速框架。

sentences.en: Turbo4DGen introduces a spatiotemporal cache mechanism that persistently reuses intermediate attention across denoising steps, combined with dynamically semantic-aware attention pruning and an adaptive SCM chain bypass scheduler, to drastically reduce redundant SCM attention computation.
sentences.zh: Turbo4DGen 引入一个时空缓存机制，它跨去噪步骤持续重用中间注意力，并结合动态语义感知注意力剪枝与自适应 SCM 链旁路调度器，大幅减少冗余的 SCM 注意力计算。

sentences.en: Our experimental results show that Turbo4DGen achieves an average 9.7$\times$ speedup without quality degradation on the ObjaverseDy and Consistent4D datasets.
sentences.zh: 我们的实验结果表明，Turbo4DGen 在 ObjaverseDy 与 Consistent4D 数据集上实现平均 9.7$\times$ 加速且质量不退化。

sentences.en: To the best of our knowledge, Turbo4DGen is the first dedicated acceleration framework for 4D generation.
sentences.zh: 据我们所知，Turbo4DGen 是首个专用于 4D 生成的加速框架。

authors.name: Miao Yin
authors.institution: The University of Texas at Arlington

title_en: TurboGS: Accelerating 3D Gaussian Splatting via Error-Guided Sparse Pixel Sampling and Optimization
title_zh: TurboGS：经误差引导的稀疏像素采样与优化加速 3D 高斯溅射

sentences.en: Consumer-level applications require fast optimization of 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) with high-fidelity novel view rendering.
sentences.zh: 消费级应用需要高保真新视角渲染下的 3D 高斯溅射（3DGS）快速优化。

sentences.en: However, existing 3DGS acceleration approaches still incur substantial computation on redundant pixels while sacrificing fine details.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有 3DGS 加速方法仍在冗余像素上投入大量计算，同时牺牲细节。

sentences.en: In this paper, we present TurboGS, an error-guided training framework that accelerates 3DGS by concentrating optimization on perceptually informative pixels.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们提出 TurboGS，一个误差引导的训练框架，通过将优化集中在感知上有信息量的像素上来加速 3DGS。

sentences.en: TurboGS is built upon four core components: (1) a tile-wise sparse pixel sampling, which, driven by multi-view reconstruction errors during training, prioritizes challenging regions and skips well-reconstructed ones to avoid redundant gradient computation; (2) a tile-wise structure-aware loss with sparse Normalized Cross-Correlation, which provides sparse yet effective supervision to preserve fine details and stabilize training; (3) an error-driven Gaussian density control strategy, which dynamically allocates model capacity and removes redundant primitives; and (4) a tailored hybrid optimizer that couples Hessian-informed updates with Adam moment damping to stabilize and improve convergence under sparse supervision.
sentences.zh: TurboGS 建立在四个核心组件之上：（1）分块稀疏像素采样，它在训练期间受多视图重建误差驱动，优先处理困难区域并跳过重建良好的区域，以避免冗余梯度计算；（2）带稀疏归一化互相关的分块结构感知损失，它提供稀疏而有效的监督以保留细节并稳定训练；（3）误差驱动的高斯密度控制策略，它动态分配模型容量并移除冗余图元；以及（4）一个定制的混合优化器，它将 Hessian 知情更新与 Adam 动量衰减耦合，以在稀疏监督下稳定并改进收敛。

sentences.en: Experiments on standard benchmarks demonstrate that TurboGS can deliver on par or superior rendering quality within 100 seconds (up to 10x training speedup over vanilla 3DGS).
sentences.zh: 在标准基准上的实验表明，TurboGS 可以在 100 秒内产生相当或更优的渲染质量（相对 vanilla 3DGS 最高 10x 训练加速）。

title_en: Turning Adaptation into Assets: Cross-Domain Bridging for Online Vision-Language Navigation
title_zh: 将适应变成资产：面向在线视觉-语言导航的跨域桥接

sentences.en: Navigating under non-stationary environment shifts poses a critical challenge for a Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) agent deployed in the wild.
sentences.zh: 在非平稳环境变化下导航对部署在现实场景中的视觉-语言导航（VLN）智能体构成关键挑战。

sentences.en: Yet, existing Test-Time Adaptation (TTA) methods for VLN largely treat online adaptation as transient, isolated updates, leading to catastrophic forgetting and negative transfer.
sentences.zh: 然而，针对 VLN 的现有测试时适应（TTA）方法在很大程度上将在线适应视为短暂、孤立的更新，导致灾难性遗忘与负迁移。

sentences.en: To overcome these issues, we propose **I**nter-**D**omain Bridg**E** with Historical **A**ssets (**IDEA**), a novel TTA framework that transforms adaptation into the accumulation and composition of assets.
sentences.zh: 为克服这些问题，我们提出 **I**nter-**D**omain Bridg**E** with Historical **A**ssets（**IDEA**，带历史资产的跨域桥接），一个新颖的 TTA 框架，它将适应转化为资产的累积与组合。

sentences.en: Specifically, IDEA introduces soft prompts optimized via a Fisher-guided weighting scheme to capture the transferable knowledge.
sentences.zh: 具体地，IDEA 引入经 Fisher 引导加权方案优化的软提示，以捕获可迁移知识。

sentences.en: These optimized prompts are then augmented with domain coordinates to form a dynamic asset library.
sentences.zh: 这些优化后的提示随后与域坐标结合，形成一个动态资产库。

sentences.en: Leveraging this library, IDEA constructs a cross-domain bridge by projecting the target domain onto the convex hull of historical knowledge.
sentences.zh: 利用这一资产库，IDEA 通过将目标域投影到历史知识凸包上构建跨域桥。

sentences.en: These designs form a complementary loop: the evolving library underpins bridge construction, while the bridge provides superior initialization to accelerate asset optimization.
sentences.zh: 这些设计形成一个互补循环：演化的资产库支撑桥的构建，而桥提供优越的初始化以加速资产优化。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments across REVERIE, R2R, and R2R-CE benchmarks demonstrate the consistent superiority of IDEA over existing methods, showcasing its ability to enable training-free adaptation via asset sharing.
sentences.zh: 在 REVERIE、R2R 与 R2R-CE 基准上的大量实验展示了 IDEA 相对现有方法的一致优越性，彰显其通过资产共享实现免训练适应的能力。

topic: General Machine Learning->Transfer, Multitask and Meta-learning
title_en: Turning Back Without Forgetting: Selective Backward Refinement for Parameter-Efficient Continual Learning
title_zh: 回望而不遗忘：面向参数高效持续学习的选择性向后细化

sentences.en: While prompt-based parameter-efficient continual learning mitigates catastrophic forgetting by isolating task-specific prompts, this isolation also limits later tasks from improving earlier ones, leaving backward knowledge transfer underexplored.
sentences.zh: 虽然基于提示的参数高效持续学习通过隔离任务特定提示缓解灾难性遗忘，但这种隔离也限制了后续任务改进先前任务的能力，使向后知识迁移未得到充分探索。

sentences.en: We address this limitation by proposing Selective bAckward refinement for positive Backward knowledge transfER (SABER), a replay-free framework that enables controlled backward transfer in prompt-based continual learning.
sentences.zh: 我们通过提出选择性向后细化以实现正向后知识迁移（SABER），一个实现提示式持续学习中受控向后迁移的免重放框架，来应对这一局限。

sentences.en: SABER determines when backward refinement is beneficial using complementary task-correlation criteria based on prompt-gradient geometry and loss-distribution similarity, and how to perform refinement safely by restricting updates to non-interfering directions in the prompt parameter space.
sentences.zh: SABER 用基于提示梯度几何与损失分布相似性的互补任务相关性准则，确定何时向后细化有益，并通过将更新限制在提示参数空间中不干扰的方向，确定如何安全地执行细化。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments across multiple continual learning benchmarks, and diverse pretrained backbones, including T5-Large, LLaMA, and Qwen, demonstrate that SABER consistently achieves positive backward transfer while maintaining strong overall average performance.
sentences.zh: 跨多个持续学习基准与多样预训练骨干（包括 T5-Large、LLaMA 与 Qwen）的大量实验表明，SABER 在保持强劲总体平均性能的同时，一致实现正向后迁移。

authors.institution: State University of New York at Buffalo
